items.title: @_albertgu：I've always believed that intelligence should come from simple, general building blocks that learn their own abstraction
items.abstract_or_text: I've always believed that intelligence should come from simple, general building blocks that learn their own abstractions directly from raw data; in other words, the bitter lesson. I think we're finally seeing a real step towards AI that can learn from all data. Language modeling on raw bytes is a microcosm of this ideal, and to me it's a central problem in AI: if we can't build LLMs that learn end-to-end from bytes, how will we handle the rest of the world's data that we understand even less? Last year we introduced hierarchical networks (H-Nets) as a first step. Our new version finds up to 3-5x efficiency gains in controlled scaling law experiments, and at larger scale matches an open-source model trained on 11T tokens with ~10x less data and compute. The posts below walk through what we found and why we think it works.

items.abstract_zh: 我一直相信，智能应来自简单、通用的构件，这些构件直接从原始数据中学习自身的抽象；换句话说，这就是“苦涩的教训”。我认为，我们终于看到了朝向能从全部数据中学习的 AI 迈出的真正一步。对原始字节进行语言建模，是这一理想的缩影；对我来说，这是 AI 的核心问题：如果我们无法构建能够端到端从字节学习的大语言模型，那么面对我们理解得更少的世界数据时又该怎么办？去年，我们把层次网络（H-Nets）作为第一步。今年的新版本在受控缩放定律实验中实现了最高 3–5 倍的效率提升；在更大规模上，它以约少 10 倍的数据和计算量，匹配了一个使用 11 万亿 token 训练的开源模型。下面的帖子会介绍我们的发现及其工作原因。

items.abstract_or_text: Today, we’re sharing a look at our expanded system for monitoring frontier models at OpenAI, which in September helped us catch a model’s attempt to access the live internet during training. Since the Hugging Face incident—when models broke out of an internal cybersecurity investigation where we weren’t running our misalignment monitors—we’ve substantially expanded our monitoring of frontier agents. We now monitor all frontier reinforcement learning runs and evaluations, as well as all internal Codex use. When our system finds evidence of a problem that might require intervention, it rapidly alerts human responders who can investigate and take action. To detect when a model’s behavior departs from what we intended, we use several layers of monitoring. Activation probes look for patterns in a model’s internal activity. Reviewer models examine its reasoning and tool use, and investigative agents can read back through the model’s entire transcript to understand how a sequence of actions fits together and whether it warrants human review. To test whether our current system would have detected the Hugging Face incident, we replayed the recorded activity with our new monitors in place. In the replay, our monitors alerted our security team about 30 minutes after the agents escaped their sandbox. That was more than 30 hours before the point at which the agents breached Hugging Face’s systems in the original incident. In September, a model exploited a DNS misconfiguration to reach the live internet. Our monitors flagged the breach within 15 minutes, and a responder began reviewing the alert three minutes later. The alert enabled responders to investigate while the run was still underway. As we give models more autonomy, we need to know when they cross a boundary we expected to hold. We believe that monitoring is essential to catching those failures in time for people to intervene.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 介绍扩展后的前沿模型监控系统：覆盖强化学习、评测和内部 Codex 使用，结合激活探针、审查模型和调查智能体，并给出检测沙箱逃逸与 DNS 配置漏洞的时间线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是少数公开说明监控层次、响应流程和回放评估结果的前沿模型安全实践；具体效果仍主要来自 OpenAI 自报。
items.abstract_zh: 今天，我们分享 OpenAI 扩展后的前沿模型监控系统概况。该系统在 9 月帮助我们发现了一个模型试图在训练期间访问实时互联网的行为。在 Hugging Face 事件中，模型从一次内部网络安全调查中逃逸，而当时我们没有运行失配监控；此后，我们大幅扩展了对前沿智能体的监控。现在，我们监控所有前沿强化学习运行和评测，以及所有内部 Codex 使用。当系统发现可能需要干预的问题证据时，会迅速向人工响应人员发出警报，由他们调查并采取行动。为了检测模型行为是否偏离预期，我们使用多层监控：激活探针寻找模型内部活动中的模式；审查模型检查其推理和工具使用；调查智能体则可以回读模型的完整轨迹，以理解一系列动作如何关联，并判断是否需要人工审查。为了测试当前系统能否发现 Hugging Face 事件，我们在部署新监控后重放了记录的活动。在重放中，监控系统在智能体逃出沙箱约 30 分钟后向安全团队发出警报，比原事件中智能体攻破 Hugging Face 系统的时间早了 30 多个小时。9 月，一个模型利用 DNS 配置错误接入了实时互联网。我们的监控在 15 分钟内标记了这次突破，响应人员在 3 分钟后开始查看警报，使他们能够在运行仍在进行时展开调查。随着我们赋予模型更高的自主性，我们需要知道它们何时越过预期边界。我们认为，监控对于及时发现这些失败并让人类介入至关重要。

items.title: A Pharmacophore-Based Virtual Screening Approach for the Discovery of Novel P2Y 12 Receptor Ligands
creators: Anne van der Schatte van der Schatte Olivier
items.abstract_or_text: Microglia play key roles in neuroinflammation, which is a hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis. To strengthen our understanding of the molecular mechanisms of these disorders, we need to understand the complex dynamics in microglial states. Developing new positron emission tomography (PET) tracers is exceptionally useful for this purpose, as they enable the assessment of microglia dynamics and function in the living human brain. The purinergic receptor P2Y12 (P2Y 12 R) is highly expressed in the homeostatic microglial states, and thus makes for a promising biomarker. In particular, P2Y 12 R PET tracers could complement translocator protein (TSPO) and P2X 7 receptor tracers, which image microglial density or target the pro-inflammatory state, respectively. Unfortunately, current high-affinity P2Y 12 R ligands do not enter the brain because they are charged in vivo or because they are substrates for efflux transporters. Attempts to increase brain uptake by improving their physicochemical properties have not yet resulted in a successful P2Y 12 R PET tracer. This emphasizes the need for novel chemotypes. Herein, we applied a pharmacophore-based virtual screening strategy to a library of about three million compounds. As a result, we identified the imidazo[1,2- b ]pyrazolone scaffold as a promising structural class to use as a starting point for developing P2Y 12 R ligands. After extensive hit expansion and structure-activity relationship studies, the two best ligands displayed excellent binding affinity for human P2Y 12 R ( 96 : K i = 9.61 ± 1.70 nM; 109 : K i = 3.10 ± 0.34 nM) and rat P2Y 12 R ( 96 : K i = 65.6 ± 25.9 nM; 109 : K i = 17.9 ± 12.8 nM) in a radioligand binding assay. Furthermore, imidazo[1,2- b ]pyrazolone [ 18 F] 91 was successfully radiolabeled as a proof-of-concept in sufficient radiochemical yields. Future work will assess whether the more potent ligands can be radiolabeled and used to image the P2Y 12 R in the brain. Together, these results highlight the use of pharmacophore-based strategy in PET tracer development and provide a robust basis for further hit exploration.
items.summary_zh: 对约三百万个化合物进行基于药效团的虚拟筛选，发现 imidazo[1,2-b]pyrazolone 骨架，并通过命中扩展、构效关系研究和放射性配体结合实验获得 P2Y 12 R 配体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作给出了面向脑部 P2Y 12 R PET 示踪剂的新化学骨架，最佳配体对人和大鼠受体均显示低 nM 级结合亲和力，并完成了 [18F] 91 的放射性标记概念验证。限制是尚未证明脑摄取、体内成像或更强配体的可标记性。
items.abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞在神经炎症中发挥关键作用，而神经炎症是 Parkinson’s disease、Alzheimer’s disease 和 Multiple Sclerosis 等神经退行性疾病的标志。为了加深对这些疾病分子机制的理解，需要了解小胶质细胞状态的复杂动态。开发新的正电子发射断层成像（PET）示踪剂对此特别有用，因为它们能够评估活体人脑中的小胶质细胞动态和功能。嘌呤能受体 P2Y12（P2Y 12 R）在稳态小胶质细胞状态中高度表达，因此是一个有前景的生物标志物。具体而言，P2Y 12 R PET 示踪剂可以补充转运体蛋白（TSPO）和 P2X 7 receptor 示踪剂，后两者分别用于成像小胶质细胞密度或靶向促炎状态。不幸的是，当前的高亲和力 P2Y 12 R 配体由于在体内带电或是外排转运体的底物，无法进入脑内。通过改善理化性质来提高脑摄取的尝试，尚未产生成功的 P2Y 12 R PET 示踪剂。这突出了新化学类型的需求。在本研究中，我们对约三百万个化合物的库应用了基于药效团的虚拟筛选策略。结果发现，imidazo[1,2-b]pyrazolone 骨架是一类有前景的结构，可作为开发 P2Y 12 R 配体的起点。经过广泛的命中扩展和构效关系研究，两个最佳配体在人 P2Y 12 R 上显示出优异的结合亲和力（96：K i = 9.61 ± 1.70 nM；109：K i = 3.10 ± 0.34 nM），在大鼠 P2Y 12 R 上也显示出优异的结合亲和力（96：K i = 65.6 ± 25.9 nM；109：K i = 17.9 ± 12.8 nM），测定方法为放射性配体结合实验。此外，imidazo[1,2-b]pyrazolone [18F] 91 已成功完成放射性标记，作为概念验证获得了足够的放射化学产率。未来工作将评估更强效的配体能否被放射性标记并用于脑内 P2Y 12 R 成像。总体而言，这些结果凸显了基于药效团策略在 PET 示踪剂开发中的作用，并为进一步的命中探索提供了坚实基础。

items.title: Benchmarking thermoelectric property extraction from scientific text
items.abstract_or_text: We compare five methods for extracting thermoelectric property records from paragraphs of the literature (regular expressions, the ChemDataExtractor thermoelectric parsers, MaterialsBERT named-entity recognition with rule-based linking, a single-prompt large language model (LLM) and an LLM agent) on one corpus of 311 papers with one scoring rule, with all methods frozen before the 200-paragraph test sample was annotated. A record counts as correct only if property, value, temperature and material all match the gold standard. On the 160 in-scope test paragraphs (241 core records), the single-prompt LLM reached F1 = 0.79 (95% CI 0.71–0.87) and the agent 0.73 (0.64–0.83), against 0.22 for the regular-expression baseline and 0.06 for the ChemDataExtractor and NER pipelines; both LLM methods recover property, value and temperature with F1 above 0.94, and most of their remaining errors concern the material. We found no evidence of an accuracy improvement from the tested agent configuration, and we release the protocol, code, gold standard and all method outputs.
items.summary_zh: 在 311 篇论文语料上比较正则表达式、ChemDataExtractor、MaterialsBERT、单提示 LLM 和 LLM agent 对热电性质记录的抽取能力，并发布协议、金标准和输出。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了冻结方法、人工标注测试集和置信区间，显示单提示 LLM 的 F1 为 0.79，高于 agent 的 0.73，且没有证据表明所测 agent 配置提高准确率。限制是单一语料和评分规则，材料实体仍是主要错误来源。
items.abstract_zh: 我们比较了五种从文献段落中抽取热电性质记录的方法：正则表达式、ChemDataExtractor 热电解析器、带基于规则链接的 MaterialsBERT 命名实体识别、单提示大型语言模型（LLM）和 LLM agent。比较基于一个包含 311 篇论文的语料库和一套评分规则进行，所有方法均在测试样本的 200 个段落完成标注前冻结。在 160 个属于研究范围的测试段落（241 条核心记录）上，单提示 LLM 达到 F1 = 0.79（95% CI 0.71–0.87），agent 达到 0.73（0.64–0.83），而正则表达式基线为 0.22，ChemDataExtractor 和 NER 流程为 0.06；两种 LLM 方法在性质、数值和温度抽取上的 F1 均高于 0.94，其余错误大多涉及材料。我们没有发现所测试的 agent 配置带来准确率提升的证据，并发布了协议、代码、金标准和所有方法输出。

items.abstract_or_text: We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation. Since we began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that our other safeguards weren’t designed to catch. Because Claude has already read the conversation, self-assessment is very efficient. And unlike classifiers, which target a discrete set of harms, it draws on Claude’s own judgment, so it gets more accurate as our models improve. Read more on our new Safeguards blog:

items.title: Comparative Analysis of Basic Machine Learning and Rigorous Free-Energy Calculation on Benchmarking Datasets of Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity
items.abstract_or_text: Rigorous free-energy methods based on molecular dynamics simulations like free-energy perturbation (FEP) are nowadays widely applied in lead optimization in pharmaceutical companies. Due to sampling restrictions and potential force-field deficiencies, it is common practice to first validate the applicability of FEP to a target/chemical series using a small number of known compounds, before applying it prospectively. As rigorous methods require significant computational resources, we want to explore how basic machine learning (ML) methods perform under the same conditions, i.e., training on a small number of known compounds and estimating the affinity of novel variants in the same chemical series. We apply classical ML models using 2D and 3D molecular descriptors, alongside two implementations of 3D quantitative structure–activity relationship modeling, and integrate the predictions through meta-learning. For many of the standard benchmarking datasets, we find that one of the ML models matches or exceeds the performance of FEP. Interestingly, ML-based predictions generally exhibit flatter slopes in parity plots, but without substantial effect on the relative rank ordering of compounds. Given their lower computational cost and ease of deployment, basic ML methods, particularly the meta-learner, emerge as a powerful complement to rigorous free-energy methods for estimating binding affinities within chemical series.
items.summary_zh: 比较小样本经典机器学习与严格自由能计算在蛋白质–配体结合亲和力预测中的表现，并用元学习整合 2D/3D 分子描述符和 3D 定量构效关系模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示，在多个标准基准数据集上，低成本、易部署的 ML 模型可达到或超过 FEP，适合作为先导优化中的补充工具。限制是研究基于既有基准数据，ML 预测的 parity plot 斜率通常更平，绝对亲和力校准仍需谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 基于分子动力学模拟的严格自由能方法（如自由能微扰，FEP）如今已广泛用于制药公司的先导优化。由于采样受限和力场可能存在缺陷，通常会先用少量已知化合物验证 FEP 对某一靶点/化学系列的适用性，再开展前瞻性应用。由于严格方法需要大量计算资源，我们希望探索基础机器学习（ML）方法在相同条件下的表现，即在少量已知化合物上训练，并估计同一化学系列中新变体的亲和力。我们使用基于 2D 和 3D 分子描述符的经典 ML 模型，以及两种 3D 定量构效关系建模实现，并通过元学习整合预测。在许多标准基准数据集中，我们发现其中一种 ML 模型的表现可达到或超过 FEP。有趣的是，ML 预测通常在 parity plot 中呈现更平的斜率，但对化合物相对排序没有显著影响。鉴于基础 ML 方法（尤其是元学习器）计算成本更低且易于部署，它们成为在化学系列内估计结合亲和力时严格自由能方法的有力补充。

items.title: Computer-Guided In-situ Screening of Poly(acetylene)s for Gene Delivery
items.abstract_or_text: We report a new methodology for the discovery of polymer-based gene vectors that enables the simultaneous optimization of polymer composition and polyplex formulation, while bypassing the need to prepare, isolate, and characterise new candidates using conventional polymer synthesis. At the core of this approach is the combination of computer-aided experimental design, in situ screening of polymer composition and polyplex formulation, and machine learning, which allows us to treat polymer synthesis and formulation as a single optimizable problem. Central to this methodology is a new reactive and water-soluble poly(acetylene), poly(N-(propargyl)-2-(aminooxy)-acetamide), which can be functionalized in aqueous conditions with readily available aldehydes. This provides candidate polymers under biologically compatible conditions, which are then directly complexed with nucleic acids and evaluated within the same workflow. Iterative modelling then correlates inputs readily controlled by the operator—such as reagent concentrations and ratios—with the key performance metric, transfection efficiency, guiding subsequent rounds of candidate generation. In doing so, we move beyond post hoc correlations of physicochemical properties to establish an iterative, data-driven methodology for materials discovery. Ultimately, this methodology has unlocked the potential of poly(acetylene)s, a polymer family not previously explored in this context, to move beyond compositional mimicry and capture the dynamic helicity that underpins nucleic acid complexation and delivery in natural systems.
items.summary_zh: 将计算机辅助实验设计、聚合物组成与 polyplex 配方的原位筛选和机器学习结合，在同一迭代流程中优化 poly(acetylene) 基因递送载体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把聚合物合成与配方优化作为联合问题，减少逐个制备、分离和表征候选物的需要，并在水相、相容生物条件下直接评估转染效率。摘要未报告具体转染数值、体内结果或长期稳定性，应用潜力仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 我们报告了一种用于发现聚合物基因载体的新方法，可以同时优化聚合物组成和 polyplex 配方，同时绕过使用传统聚合物合成方法制备、分离和表征新候选物的需要。该方法的核心是结合计算机辅助实验设计、聚合物组成与 polyplex 配方的原位筛选以及机器学习，使我们能够把聚合物合成和配方视为一个可优化的整体问题。该方法的核心材料是一种新的、具有反应性且水溶性的 poly(acetylene)，即 poly(N-(propargyl)-2-(aminooxy)-acetamide)，它可以在水相条件下用易得的醛进行功能化。这样便可在与生物相容的条件下获得候选聚合物，随后直接与核酸形成复合物，并在同一流程中进行评估。迭代建模随后将操作人员可以直接控制的输入（如试剂浓度和比例）与关键性能指标——转染效率——联系起来，从而指导后续候选物生成。通过这种方式，我们超越了对理化性质进行事后相关分析，建立了一种迭代式、数据驱动的材料发现方法。最终，该方法释放了 poly(acetylene) 的潜力：这一此前未在该领域探索的聚合物家族，有望超越组成模仿，捕捉支撑天然体系中核酸复合与递送的动态螺旋性。

items.title: Foldability Is an Intrinsic Property of Protein Sequences: A Lattice Model Study with Information-Theoretic Approach and Unsupervised Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Protein structure prediction has been largely solved, but why a given sequence is foldable has not. We address this question for 27-, 48- and 64-residue lattice heteropolymers with statistical thermodynamics, the informationtheoretic approach (ITA) and a variational autoencoder (VAE). Native populations, folding probabilities and freeenergy surfaces are reproducible and independent of the initial denatured ensemble, so foldability is an intrinsic property of the sequence at a given temperature and solvent. We then ask where the observed regularities come from. Stability is governed by an information balance: the information content (self-information) of the native energy relative to the maximum-entropy description of compact alternatives, ℐtail, must exceed their Shannon entropy, 𝑆c = ln𝛺c. This is the random-energy-model condition for a folding transition, and ℐtail/𝑆c fixes the ratio of folding to glass temperatures, recasting minimal frustration in information units. Foldable sequences have smooth funnels, minimal Shannon entropy and minimal Fisher information in the native state, and a single sharp maximum of Fisher information at melting (cooperativity). Mutual and conditional information show that stability is an approximately sufficient statistic for kinetic accessibility of compact 27-mers. No hierarchical folding order is found. Variational autoencoders trained without labels distinguish sequences by their folding ensembles, supply a six-variable reaction coordinate that retains 91% of the kinetic information in the full native-contact map, and rediscover the native energy gap from the density of compact states.
items.summary_zh: 在 27、48 和 64 残基晶格杂聚物上结合统计热力学、信息论方法和无监督 VAE，研究蛋白序列可折叠性的内在决定因素。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把折叠转变、稳定性、最小挫折和动力学可达性统一到信息平衡框架，并显示无标签 VAE 可用六变量反应坐标保留完整接触图 91% 的动力学信息。限制是模型为简化晶格体系，不能直接替代真实蛋白的结构和动力学验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构预测在很大程度上已经解决，但为什么某一给定序列能够折叠仍是未知问题。我们针对 27、48 和 64 残基的晶格杂聚物，结合统计热力学、信息论方法（ITA）和变分自编码器（VAE）来研究这一问题。天然态布居、折叠概率和自由能面具有可重复性，并且与初始变性集合无关，因此在给定温度和溶剂条件下，可折叠性是序列的内在性质。随后，我们询问观察到的规律从何而来。稳定性受信息平衡支配：相对于紧凑替代构象的最大熵描述，天然态能量的信息量（自信息）ℐtail 必须超过其 Shannon 熵，𝑆c = ln𝛺c。这是折叠转变的随机能模型条件，而 ℐtail/𝑆c 决定折叠温度与玻璃化温度之比，从而以信息单位重新表述最小挫折。可折叠序列具有平滑的漏斗、最小的 Shannon 熵和天然态中最小的 Fisher 信息，并在熔解时出现 Fisher 信息的单一尖锐峰值（协同性）。互信息和条件信息表明，对于紧凑的 27 聚体，稳定性近似是动力学可达性的充分统计量。没有发现分层折叠顺序。无标签训练的变分自编码器能够根据折叠集合区分序列，提供一个六变量反应坐标，该坐标保留了完整天然接触图中 91% 的动力学信息，并从紧凑态密度中重新发现天然能隙。

items.title: CellMethMarker provides an integrated database of human cell- and tissue-type-specific DNA methylation markers
items.abstract_or_text: Cell- and tissue-type-specific DNA methylation markers provide epigenetic signatures of cellular identity and are widely used to infer cellular origin from bulk and single-cell methylomes. Existing resources mainly emphasize disease-associated biomarkers, methylome atlases, genomic annotations or RNA-based cell markers, leaving an unmet need for an integrated region-level resource dedicated to such markers. Here we present CellMethMarker (http://gu-zhanglab.hfcas.ac.cn/CellMethMarker), a curated database integrating 347,514 de novo markers derived from uniformly processed whole-genome and reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing datasets, 2,203,507 literature-derived marker records and harmonized metadata for 2,810 samples. CellMethMarker enables cell- and tissue-centered marker retrieval, coordinate-based search, genome-browser visualization, interactive methylation analysis and data download. In an independent single-cell methylome atlas, these markers recover the expected cell-type-associated methylation patterns, and a platform-matched reference built from them lowers the mean deconvolution error from 0.365 to 0.144. CellMethMarker therefore links region-level DNA methylation variation to cellular identity and supports methylome-based cell-type annotation and deconvolution.
items.summary_zh: CellMethMarker 整合 347,514 个从头甲基化标记、2,203,507 条文献标记和 2,810 个样本元数据，并在独立单细胞甲基化图谱中降低去卷积误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；资源规模、统一处理流程和独立验证较完整，可支持细胞来源推断，但数据库标记的跨平台稳定性仍需更多外部数据评估。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞类型和组织类型特异性 DNA 甲基化标记提供了细胞身份的表观遗传特征，广泛用于从 bulk 和单细胞甲基化组推断细胞来源。现有资源主要强调疾病相关生物标志物、甲基化组图谱、基因组注释或基于 RNA 的细胞标记，缺少专门面向此类标记的整合性区域级资源。我们提出 CellMethMarker（http://gu-zhanglab.hfcas.ac.cn/CellMethMarker），这是一个经过整理的数据库，整合了从统一处理的全基因组和简化代表性亚硫酸氢盐测序数据集中得到的 347,514 个从头标记、2,203,507 条文献来源标记，以及 2,810 个样本的协调元数据。CellMethMarker 支持以细胞和组织为中心的标记检索、基于坐标的搜索、基因组浏览器可视化、交互式甲基化分析和数据下载。在一个独立的单细胞甲基化组图谱中，这些标记能够恢复预期的细胞类型相关甲基化模式；使用由这些标记构建的平台匹配参考集后，平均去卷积误差由 0.365 降至 0.144。因此，CellMethMarker 将区域级 DNA 甲基化变异与细胞身份联系起来，并支持基于甲基化组的细胞类型注释和去卷积。

items.title: MedTrustGraph: Purpose-Aware Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Zero-Trust Authorization of Autonomous Clinical LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve patient data, invoke clinical tools and execute multi-step tasks inside electronic health record (EHR) systems. Authenticating an agent session does not establish that each subsequent action is consistent with the clinician’s purpose, the assigned patient or the agent’s delegated authority. Objectives: We study continuous, purpose-aware authorization of individual clinical-agent actions, and test whether temporal graph structure and explicit patient and purpose context improve detection of unauthorized actions over event-level, sequential and static graph models. Methods: We propose MedTrustGraph, which represents clinicians, agents, patients, tools, FHIR resources and clinical purposes as typed nodes connected by timestamped interactions. A graph attention encoder produces event embeddings that a causal gated recurrent unit processes in temporal order; patient-scope and purpose-scope checks supply Zero-Trust context; and a Platt-calibrated risk estimate is mapped to ALLOW, VERIFY or DENY by a deterministic policy engine that retains final authority. We built a synthetic FHIR-style benchmark modelled on MedAgentBench with 5,000 agent trajectories and 36,855 access events (8,448 unauthorized) spanning cross-patient access, purpose drift, privilege escalation and bulk record retrieval, evaluated on a chronological trajectory-level 70/15/15 split. Results: Using only leakage-safe observable features, the temporal graph model reached F1 =0.8905, AUROC =0.9767 and AUPRC =0.9517, versus F1 =0.8062 for XGBoost and 0.7918 for a static graph attention network. In a controlled ablation configuration the full model reached F1 =0.9653 (95% CI 0.9544–0.9741); removing patient context, purpose context, graph structure or temporal structure lowered F1 by 0.2173, 0.0200, 0.0188 and 0.0174 (all Holm-adjusted p −4 ). Shuffling event order lowered F1 to 0.8279, while removing 30% of edges changed it by under 0.002. The calibrated policy layer allowed 0 of 652 unauthorized events (95% CI 0–0.59%) and auto-allowed 98.64% of authorized events with a 1.90% verification workload. The code and data are available at https://github.com/Kamrul01685/MedTrustGraph. Conclusions: On this benchmark, temporal order and patient/purpose context carry authorization signal beyond event-level and static-graph models, and separating learned risk from deterministic policy yields a low-workload decision layer. Because benchmark labels were generated from patient- and purpose-scope rules, context-augmented scores are upper bounds; validation on real or independently generated agent traces is required.
items.summary_zh: MedTrustGraph 将临床智能体授权建模为带时间戳的异构图，并结合患者范围、目的范围和确定性策略层，在合成 FHIR 基准上识别越权访问。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；有时间顺序划分、消融、代码和数据发布，且明确承认合成标签使结果偏乐观；结果不能替代真实 EHR 轨迹验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以在电子健康记录（EHR）系统中检索患者数据、调用临床工具并执行多步骤任务。对智能体会话进行身份认证，并不能证明后续每个动作都符合临床医生的目的、指定患者或智能体被授予的权限。目标：研究对单个临床智能体动作进行持续的、目的感知的授权，并检验时间图结构以及显式患者和目的上下文是否能比事件级、序列模型和静态图模型更好地检测未授权动作。方法：我们提出 MedTrustGraph，将临床医生、智能体、患者、工具、FHIR 资源和临床目的表示为类型化节点，并用带时间戳的交互连接。图注意力编码器生成事件嵌入，因果门控循环单元按时间顺序处理这些嵌入；患者范围和目的范围检查提供零信任上下文；经 Platt 校准的风险估计被映射为 ALLOW、VERIFY 或 DENY，最终决定权保留在确定性策略引擎中。我们构建了一个以 MedAgentBench 为模型的合成 FHIR 风格基准，包含 5,000 条智能体轨迹和 36,855 个访问事件，其中 8,448 个为未授权事件，覆盖跨患者访问、目的漂移、权限提升和批量记录检索；使用按时间顺序的轨迹级 70/15/15 划分进行评估。结果：仅使用防止泄漏的可观测特征时，时间图模型达到 F1 = 0.8905、AUROC = 0.9767 和 AUPRC = 0.9517，而 XGBoost 的 F1 = 0.8062，静态图注意力网络的 F1 = 0.7918。在受控消融配置中，完整模型达到 F1 = 0.9653（95% CI 0.9544–0.9741）；移除患者上下文、目的上下文、图结构或时间结构后，F1 分别下降 0.2173、0.0200、0.0188 和 0.0174（所有 Holm 校正的 p −4）。打乱事件顺序后 F1 降至 0.8279，而移除 30% 的边后变化小于 0.002。经校准的策略层允许 0/652 个未授权事件（95% CI 0–0.59%），并自动允许 98.64% 的授权事件，验证工作量为 1.90%。代码和数据可从 https://github.com/Kamrul01685/MedTrustGraph 获取。结论：在该基准上，时间顺序以及患者/目的上下文携带了超出事件级和静态图模型的授权信号，将学习到的风险与确定性策略分离可形成低工作量决策层。由于基准标签由患者范围和目的范围规则生成，加入上下文的得分属于上界；仍需在真实或独立生成的智能体轨迹上验证。

items.title: The Generalist Strikes Back:\\A General LLM Agent Outperforms Specialist Bioinformatics Agents on Free-Form, End-to-End Benchmark Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Specialist agents such as Biomni, STELLA and ToolsGenie wrap large language models in curated tools and multi-agent scaffolds for bioinformatics. We asked whether a current frontier model in an off-the-shelf coding harness still needs them. Claude Opus 5.5 (high effort) in Claude Code solved all 244 tasks of PromptBio-Bench, whose free-form output files are scored against expert references. It was run with and without 667 bioinformatics Agent Skills (bioSkills, ClawBio). Under the original evaluation framework with GPT-5.6 judges, Claude with skills completed every task and reached 0.869 accuracy, against 0.758 for Biomni and ToolsGenie and 0.717 for STELLA (paired McNemar p ≤ 2 × 10−4). Its failures exposed eleven evaluator defects and several incorrect reference answers. With these defects fixed, Claude reached 0.918 to 0.926 with skills and 0.873 to 0.902 without, across GPT and Claude judges that agreed on 95 to 98% of tasks. Skills added only 2.5 to 4.5 points, yet transcripts showed the agent never invoked one; the gap traces to run-to-run variation in a few judgement calls. Of the 18 tasks still failed, 11 trace to defective references or unstated settings, and most of the rest are defensible alternatives to the reference. A general-purpose frontier model now matches or exceeds purpose-built bioinformatics agents on realistic analyses; benchmark reliability, not agent capability, has become the main limit on measuring progress.
items.summary_zh: 在 PromptBio-Bench 的 244 个自由形式生物信息学任务中，通用前沿模型智能体达到或超过多个专用智能体；研究同时发现评测器缺陷和参考答案错误显著影响分数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；任务全覆盖、双评测器一致性和缺陷修订分析较有价值，但结论依赖特定模型、提示和评测框架，不能泛化为所有生物信息学工作流。
items.abstract_zh: 专用智能体（如 Biomni、STELLA 和 ToolsGenie）将大型语言模型封装在精选工具和多智能体脚手架中。我们考察当前前沿模型在开箱即用的编码框架中是否仍需要这些专用系统。Claude Opus 5.5（高 effort）在 PromptBio-Bench 的全部 244 个任务上完成了任务；该基准的自由格式输出文件会与专家参考答案比较。模型分别在有和没有 667 个生物信息学 Agent Skills（bioSkills、ClawBio）的情况下运行。在原始评测框架下，使用 skills 的 Claude 完成了全部任务并达到 0.869 的准确率，而 Biomni 和 ToolsGenie 为 0.758，STELLA 为 0.717（配对 McNemar p ≤ 2 × 10−4）。其失败案例暴露出 11 个评测器缺陷和若干错误参考答案。修正这些缺陷后，在 GPT 和 Claude 评测器上，使用 skills 的 Claude 达到 0.918–0.926，不使用 skills 时达到 0.873–0.902；不同评测器对 95–98% 的任务给出一致判断。skills 只增加 2.5–4.5 个百分点，但运行记录显示智能体从未调用其中的 skills；差距源于少数判断的运行间变异。在仍未完成的 18 个任务中，11 个可追溯到有缺陷的参考答案或未说明的设置，其余大多数是相对于参考答案而言有理据的替代方案。通用前沿模型如今在现实分析中达到或超过面向特定任务构建的生物信息学智能体；评测基准的可靠性，而不是智能体能力，已成为衡量进步的主要限制。
items.author_line: Zhang X

items.title: Tumor Associated Neutrophils Extend NETs To Spatially Drive Necroptosis In Glioblastoma
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Glioblastoma is pathologically characterized by extensive pseudopalisading necrosis, a hallmark linked to therapeutic resistance and dismal prognosis. While traditionally viewed as a passive ischemic event, the precise radiogenomic drivers and spatial immune architectures orchestrating active tumor necrosis remain poorly understood. Methods: We integrated macroscopic clinical MRI radiomics with public genomic datasets (n=3,639), single-cell spatial transcriptomics, and high-resolution protein immunofluorescence (IF) assays in a novel co-mutant murine model to map the necrotic microenvironment. Results: Radiomic analysis of patient MRIs demonstrated that high tumoral necrotic volume serves as a powerful independent biomarker for poor long-term survival. This macro-structural necrosis phenotype is radiogenomically driven by cell-intrinsic TP53, PTEN, and NF1 (PPN) co-mutations. Spatial transcriptomic profiling of PPN-deficient tumors revealed distinct cellular topography, separating a proliferative, invasive niche (EGFR+ SOX+, Type Inv ) from a hyper-aggressive necrotic niche (ERBB3+, Type Nec ). Mechanistically, TypeNec cells deploy a prominent CCL5/CXCL2 chemokine milieu that actively recruits and prompts tumor-associated neutrophils to undergo neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation. This overactive neutrophil infiltrate drives a feed-forward loop of intrinsic tumor necroptosis mediated by the release of the damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) protein HMGB2. This cascade could be therapeutically dismantled using targeted anti-inflammatory compounds. Finally, multi-cohort clinical validation confirmed that an HMGB2 high signature dictates a high-risk, myeloid-rich immunosuppressive microenvironment in glioblastoma patients. Conclusions: Our findings redefine glioblastoma necrosis as an active, mutation-driven immunopathological process. The HMGB2-mediated DAMP necroptosis cascade and associated myeloid chemokines provide robust prognostic biomarkers and immediate therapeutic vulnerabilities to disrupt the immunosuppressive necrotic niche.
items.summary_zh: 研究整合 MRI 放射组学、3,639 例公共基因组数据、空间转录组和高分辨率免疫荧光，提出 TP53/PTEN/NF1 共突变驱动的中性粒细胞 NET—HMGB2—坏死性凋亡轴。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；从患者影像、组学、空间定位到共突变小鼠模型形成多层证据链，并有多队列临床验证；机制和治疗脆弱性仍需独立实验与临床研究确认。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：胶质母细胞瘤的病理特征是广泛的栅栏状坏死，这一标志与治疗耐药和极差预后相关。虽然传统上将其视为被动缺血事件，但驱动主动肿瘤坏死的精确放射基因组因素和空间免疫结构仍不清楚。方法：我们整合宏观临床 MRI 放射组学、公共基因组数据（n = 3,639）、单细胞空间转录组以及在新型共突变小鼠模型中开展的高分辨率蛋白免疫荧光（IF）实验，以绘制坏死微环境。结果：患者 MRI 的放射组学分析显示，较高的肿瘤坏死体积是长期生存不良的强独立生物标志物。这种宏观结构性坏死表型由细胞内 TP53、PTEN 和 NF1（PPN）共突变驱动。PPN 缺失肿瘤的空间转录组分析揭示了不同的细胞拓扑结构，将增殖性、侵袭性生态位（EGFR+ SOX+，Type Inv）与高侵袭性坏死生态位（ERBB3+，Type Nec）区分开来。机制上，Type Nec 细胞产生显著的 CCL5/CXCL2 趋化因子环境，主动募集肿瘤相关中性粒细胞并促使其形成中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NET）。这种过度活跃的中性粒细胞浸润通过释放损伤相关分子模式（DAMP）蛋白 HMGB2，驱动肿瘤坏死性凋亡的正反馈环。利用靶向抗炎化合物可以拆解这一级联反应。最后，多队列临床验证证实，HMGB2 高表达特征决定了胶质母细胞瘤患者中高风险、富含髓系细胞的免疫抑制微环境。结论：我们的发现重新定义了胶质母细胞瘤坏死，将其视为由突变驱动的主动免疫病理过程。HMGB2 介导的 DAMP—坏死性凋亡级联及相关髓系趋化因子提供了稳健的预后生物标志物和可即时检验的治疗脆弱性，可用于干扰免疫抑制性坏死生态位。

items.title: Creator 1.0: Phylogeny-Guided Stagewise Pretraining for Plant Genome Foundation Models across 1,000 Species
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic language models have advanced DNA sequence analysis, but their applicability to plant-specific tasks and representation changes during pretraining remain poorly characterized. Here, we present Creator 1.0, a 2-billion-parameter parameter plant genome foundation model pretrained on 1,000 plant genomes using phylogeny-guided stagewise pretraining (PGSP). Training comprised 83 consecutive stages and produced 52 cumulative checkpoints associated with distinct plant orders. On GENEB, the stage 83 checkpoint ranked first among 46 models across 10 plant-related tasks, with a mean Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.565, and fourth across all 100 tasks. Evaluation of 52 checkpoints on six plant lncRNA tasks identified different optimal stages under full-data, 10-shot and 1-shot settings, corresponding to stages 71, 72 and 29, respectively. Checkpoint performance varied across tasks, without consistent advantages for corresponding plant orders. These findings demonstrate the competitive performance of Creator 1.0 and highlight the potential of PGSP to provide task-adaptable checkpoints for plant genomic applications.
items.summary_zh: Creator 1.0 是在 1,000 个植物基因组上以系统发育引导分阶段预训练的 2B 参数模型，83 个阶段和 52 个检查点在植物基因组任务中表现具有任务依赖性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；规模化跨物种训练和多检查点评估揭示了分阶段预训练的任务适配性，但不同植物类群对应阶段并未稳定带来优势，仍需外部任务验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组语言模型推动了 DNA 序列分析，但其对植物特异性任务的适用性以及预训练过程中表征的变化仍缺乏充分研究。在此，我们提出 Creator 1.0，这是一个 2 billion 参数的植物基因组基础模型，使用系统发育引导的分阶段预训练（PGSP）在 1,000 个植物基因组上进行预训练。训练包含 83 个连续阶段，并产生了与不同植物目相对应的 52 个累积检查点。在 GENEB 上，第 83 阶段检查点在 10 个植物相关任务的 46 个模型中排名第一，平均 Matthews 相关系数（MCC）为 0.565；在全部 100 个任务中排名第四。对 52 个检查点在 6 个植物 lncRNA 任务上的评估显示，在全数据、10-shot 和 1-shot 设置下，最优阶段分别为 71、72 和 29。不同检查点的性能随任务变化，并未持续显示出与相应植物目匹配的优势。这些结果展示了 Creator 1.0 具有竞争力的性能，并表明 PGSP 可以为植物基因组应用提供适配任务的检查点。

items.title: Richer database context improves LLM-generated EHR phenotyping algorithms
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.
items.summary_zh: 8 个 LLM 在逐步增加 OMOP 数据库上下文后生成 T2DM 表型 SQL；代码簿和样本行显著提高可执行性与召回率，但真实 UNC EHR 上 PPV 仍有限。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；同时比较合成 OMOP 与真实 EHR，清楚展示数据库上下文对临床表型生成的影响；真实数据上的精度不足意味着必须进行本地验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估大型语言模型（LLM）生成 2 型糖尿病（T2DM）表型 SQL 的能力，以及数据库实现上下文的影响。材料与方法：8 个公开可访问的基于 LLM 的系统，在逐步增加提示信息的条件下，使用合成数据和北卡罗来纳大学（UNC）Health 电子健康记录（EHR）数据生成 SQL；两者均基于 Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership（OMOP）模型。输出结果与 Electronic Medical Records and Genomics（eMERGE）T2DM 参考表型进行比较，指标包括 SQL 可执行性、F1、阳性预测值（PPV）和召回率。结果：在有限上下文下，合成数据输出中少于 55% 可直接执行，而 UNC EHR 输出没有一个无需修改即可执行。详细代码簿（L3）将可执行性提高到合成 OMOP 的 81.3% 和 UNC EHR 的 100%；加入样本行（L4）后，合成数据的可执行性达到 100%。有限上下文下召回率最低可至 0.01，而高上下文输出在合成 L4 中达到召回率 ≥ 0.99，在 UNC L3 中超过 0.90，尽管 UNC 的 PPV 仍显著低于召回率。在可获得的最高上下文级别，合成 OMOP 中各模型的 β F1 为 0.72–0.99，UNC EHR 中为 0.57–0.68；所有 UNC 模型都超过诊断代码基线（F1 = 0.54）。合成数据中表现最佳的模型在 UNC EHR 上的 F1 从 0.99 降至 0.64。讨论：更丰富的数据库上下文与更稳定的 SQL 可执行性和召回率相关，而模型排名随数据集变化。结论：在提供足够数据库上下文时，LLM 可以生成具有临床意义的 T2DM 表型 SQL，但真实世界数据中有限的 PPV 强调了本地验证的必要性。
items.author_line: Ye, M., Lee, H., Gizlice, S., Tobias, M., O'Neil, S., Pfaff, E., Ahalt, S. C.

items.title: BLOOM: Biologically Informed Flow Matching for Transcriptomic Virtual Embryo Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Constructing a virtual embryo requires a generative representation of how heterogeneous cell populations change across developmental time. Here we introduce BLOOM, a biologically informed framework for conditional generation of developmental cell populations. BLOOM integrates temporal population context with developmental and regulatory priors through conditional flow matching to generate cell-expression distributions at queried stages in either temporal direction. Evaluation spans three mouse single-cell atlases covering prenatal development, visual-cortex maturation and multi-organ endothelial specialization. In comparisons with 22 time-series forecasting baselines, BLOOM ranks first for gene- and cell-expression correlations across all three datasets. Measured-stage evaluations support recovery of developmental expression patterns, population organization and marker-specific temporal relationships. Biological analyses connect these predictions to cell-state identities, gene programmes and regulatory associations. At unmeasured stages, interpolation and autoregressive history and future rollouts extend simulated expression dynamics between and beyond measured timepoints. Analyses of marker genes and temporal descriptors identify candidate differences in the timing of muscle-associated, neural and vascular-specialization programmes. Input-based gene perturbations further probe predicted responses of edited genes and associated molecular programmes across time. Together, BLOOM supports transcriptomic virtual embryo modeling by bridging temporal sampling gaps, exploring extended developmental trajectories and prioritizing gene-dependent hypotheses for experimental investigation.
items.summary_zh: BLOOM 通过生物学先验和条件 flow matching 生成不同发育阶段的单细胞表达分布，在 3 个小鼠图谱和 22 个时间序列基线中评估虚拟胚胎建模。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；覆盖多个发育系统并比较 22 个基线，可用于填补时间采样空缺和提出扰动假设；生成轨迹仍需实验验证，不能直接视为真实发育因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: 构建虚拟胚胎需要一种生成式表征，用于描述异质细胞群体如何随发育时间变化。我们提出 BLOOM，一种具有生物学信息的条件生成框架，用于生成发育中的细胞群体。BLOOM 通过条件 flow matching 将时间群体上下文与发育和调控先验结合起来，从而在查询阶段沿时间正向或反向生成细胞表达分布。评估覆盖 3 个小鼠单细胞图谱：产前发育、视觉皮层成熟和多器官内皮特化。在与 22 个时间序列预测基线的比较中，BLOOM 在全部 3 个数据集的基因表达和细胞表达相关性指标上排名第一。对已测量阶段的评估支持其恢复发育表达模式、群体组织以及标记基因特异性的时间关系。在未测量阶段，插值以及基于自回归的历史和未来 rollout 可将模拟的表达动态扩展到已测时间点之间及其之外。对标记基因和时间描述符的分析发现了肌肉相关、神经和血管特化程序在时间安排上的候选差异。基于输入的基因扰动进一步探查了编辑基因及其相关分子程序随时间的预测响应。总体而言，BLOOM 通过连接时间采样间隙、探索延伸的发育轨迹并优先提出依赖基因的假设，为转录组虚拟胚胎建模提供了支持。
items.author_line: Liang, Z., Li, S., Li, B., Huang, Y., Yu, L.

items.title: Uncovering Why LLMs Fail: From Internal Mechanisms to Adversarial Reasoning Trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated by final-output correctness or safety, yet an endpoint label does not reveal how a failure develops throughout the reasoning process. We therefore ask whether ordinary reasoning failures and adversarially induced failures can be characterized using the same internal coordinates. Towards this end, we in this paper study a white-box diagnostic framework CauTrace to disclose the root-cause of why LLM fails from three fundamental inspections: Functional States, Propagation of Representation, Temporal-State Coordination and Reasoning Trajectory. First, seven functional states are creatively defined to represent the support and constraint processing in LLMs. Second, the propagation of representation change measures how the changes among the seven states persist across subsequent Transformer blocks. Third, temporal-state coordination and trajectory topology characterize when the commitment and verification occur relative to the support, and how the dominant state sequence evolves over the full inference process. Finally, we evaluate CauTrace on both clean reasoning failures and paired adversarial perturbations. Across Qwen and LLaMA-family models, the failed traces show weaker Attention-MLP agreement on support-state updates and less verification activity relative to commitment, while the exact representation-level signatures and timing shifts vary by architecture. Held-out repair and steering tests demonstrate consistent operational signals that were in line with our claims for certain models and specific settings, with aligned steering producing the predicted directional changes in process measures. Overall, CauTrace provides a unified diagnostic framework for analyzing failure dynamics through changes in support, commitment, and verification, which would shed light on the in-depth research on LLM security.
items.summary_zh: 提出白盒诊断框架 CauTrace，用功能状态、表征传播、时态状态协调和推理轨迹分析 LLM 的普通及对抗性推理失败，并通过留出修复与 steering 测试检验诊断信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“答案错了”进一步拆解为支持、承诺和验证过程中的可观测机制，为评估模型推理可靠性提供了可检验的内部指标；摘要也明确指出信号依赖模型架构和具体设置。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通常按最终输出正确性或安全性评估，但终点标签无法揭示失败如何在推理过程中发展。因此，我们探讨普通推理失败与对抗诱发失败能否用相同的内部坐标刻画。为此，本文研究白盒诊断框架 CauTrace，从功能状态、表征传播、时态状态协调和推理轨迹四项基础检查入手，揭示 LLM 失败的根本原因。首先，定义七种功能状态，用于表示 LLM 中的支持处理和约束处理。其次，表征变化的传播度量七种状态之间的变化如何在后续 Transformer 层中持续。再次，时态状态协调和轨迹拓扑刻画承诺与验证相对于支持发生的时机，以及主导状态序列如何在完整推理过程中演化。最后，我们在干净的推理失败和成对的对抗扰动上评估 CauTrace。在 Qwen 和 LLaMA 系列模型中，失败轨迹在支持状态更新上的 Attention-MLP 协同性更弱，相对于承诺而言验证活动更少；但具体的表征层面信号及其时间偏移会随架构变化。留出的修复和 steering 测试表明，在某些模型和特定设置下，操作性信号与我们的主张一致；对齐后的 steering 也产生了预测方向上的过程度量变化。总体而言，CauTrace 通过支持、承诺和验证的变化，为分析失败动力学提供了统一诊断框架，可帮助深入研究 LLM 安全性。
items.author_line: Zirui Ding, Xinxin Fan, Hao Yuan, Shaoye Luo, Men Niu, Yunfeng Lu

items.title: An Algebra of Transformers
items.abstract_or_text: On the theoretic analyses on transforms, they mainly focus on the computability analysis, such the Turing-completeness of unbounded precision transformers, the advantage of parallelizability of unbounded precision transformers and the limitations of bounded precision transformers. This paper give transformers an algebra for reasoning, which relies heavily on the functional decomposition results of transformers. This algebra uses functional decompositions as atomic actions, includes sequential composition and parallel composition, recursion for feedback and abstraction for hidden layers. As we know, it is the first attempt to model transformers logically and can be used to verify the correctness of transformer based applications.
items.summary_zh: 为 Transformer 引入由函数分解、顺序/并行组合、递归和隐藏层抽象组成的代数框架，目标是对 Transformer 应用进行逻辑建模与正确性验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接对应形式化建模和验证方向，给出可组合的推理原语；但摘要未提供定理、形式化系统实现或实验性验证细节，因此应谨慎看待其“可验证”主张。
items.abstract_zh: 关于变换的理论分析主要聚焦于可计算性分析，例如无限精度 Transformer 的图灵完备性、无限精度 Transformer 的并行化优势以及有限精度 Transformer 的局限。本文为 Transformer 构建一个用于推理的代数，这一代数高度依赖 Transformer 的函数分解结果。该代数将函数分解作为原子动作，包含顺序组合和并行组合、用于反馈的递归，以及对隐藏层的抽象。据我们所知，这是首次尝试在逻辑上对 Transformer 建模，并可用于验证基于 Transformer 的应用的正确性。
items.author_line: Yong Wang, Zhiyan Wang, Hexiao Kang

items.abstract_or_text: Are self-evolving LLM agents actually continual learners? In our new paper, we find that current self-evolving agents remain trapped in a plasticity–stability trade-off when the task distribution drifts. Many recent recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods rely on rewriting an agent’s own prompts, memory, and code at test time while model weights stay frozen, which works well on stationary benchmarks. In real-world deployments, however, new tasks, tools, and workflows keep arriving, requiring agents to adapt on the fly without forgetting earlier capabilities. To test whether they can learn continually, we evaluate 3 representative methods (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness) across 4 non-stationary task streams built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld (Topic, Workflow, Domain, and Compound drift).
items.summary_zh: Xiaoyin Chen 介绍一篇关于自进化大模型智能体的论文：在任务分布漂移下，现有方法仍受可塑性—稳定性权衡限制，并在四类非平稳任务流上评测 ReasoningBank、GEPA 和 Meta-Harness。

items.abstract_or_text: Another thing: AlphaFold is like a tiny, tiny, slice of all of biology. It's a great technical accomplishment, but it applies to static, well-formed structures (not intrinsically disordered proteins - roughly 30% of the entire proteome), and still cannot handle dynamic multimers well. It also depended on having enough data: 200,000 structures in the PDB and counting. Saying that AlphaFold works, therefore we could "solve" biology with enough compute, is like saying that because we can predict the shape of every component in a car, we can predict everything the car will do on the road. And saying that compute or reasoning can somehow magically compensate for data is a religious belief.

items.title: Adaptive Hydration-Shell ML/MM Simulations Recover Full ML Accuracy in Biomolecular Conformational Description
items.abstract_or_text: Residue-specific backbone conformational preferences govern the conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins, yet their accurate description using classical force fields is limited by prescribed functional forms that cannot fully represent environment-dependent many-body interactions. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) learn complex atomic interactions directly from quantum-mechanical reference data, providing a systematic alternative to classical parameterisations. Here, we employ a pretrained MLFF to simulate nine cationic Gly-x-Gly tripeptides in water and compare the resulting conformational ensembles against experimental NMR scalar J-couplings. To improve computational efficiency, we develop and assess hybrid Machine Learning/Molecular Mechanics (ML/MM) protocols as computationally tractable alternatives to full ML simulation. Mechanical-embedding ML/MM is found insufficient for accurate conformational sampling, as the classical treatment of peptide–solvent interactions fails to adequately represent solvation effects on backbone conformational preferences. We therefore implement an adaptive ML/MM scheme that incorporates the immediate solvation environment into the ML description and recovers near-full-ML accuracy at a reduced computational cost.
items.summary_zh: 用预训练机器学习力场模拟九种带正电的 Gly-x-Gly 三肽在水中的构象集合，比较完整 ML、机械嵌入 ML/MM 和自适应水合壳层 ML/MM，并以实验 NMR 标量 J 耦合进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 自适应方案把即时溶剂环境纳入 ML 区域，在降低成本的同时恢复接近完整 ML 的构象采样精度，为无序蛋白和溶剂化效应研究提供了更可行的折中。当前验证对象仅为九种三肽，外推到更大蛋白和更复杂体系仍需测试。
items.abstract_zh: 残基特异性的主链构象偏好决定内在无序蛋白的构象集合，但经典力场所采用的预设函数形式无法充分表示依赖环境的多体相互作用，因此难以准确描述这些偏好。机器学习力场（MLFF）直接从量子力学参考数据中学习复杂的原子相互作用，为经典参数化提供了系统性替代方案。在这里，我们使用预训练的 MLFF 模拟九种带正电的 Gly-x-Gly 三肽在水中的构象集合，并将结果与实验 NMR 标量 J 耦合进行比较。为提高计算效率，我们开发并评估了混合机器学习/分子力学（ML/MM）方案，作为完整 ML 模拟的计算可行替代方案。结果发现，机械嵌入 ML/MM 不足以进行准确的构象采样，因为肽–溶剂相互作用的经典处理无法充分表示溶剂化对主链构象偏好的影响。因此，我们实现了一种自适应 ML/MM 方案，将即时溶剂环境纳入 ML 描述，并以更低的计算成本恢复了接近完整 ML 的精度。

items.title: Machine Learning for NMR Observables Sensitive to Nuclear Quantum Effects
items.abstract_or_text: Nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) are essential for an accurate description of systems containing light elements. Their omission in classical simulations can lead to significant deviations between theoretical predictions and experimental measurements, particularly for nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) observables that are highly sensitive to quantum nuclear motion. Although NQEs can be treated rigorously by using ab initio path-integral molecular dynamics (AI-PIMD), the substantial computational cost associated with these simulations continues to limit their applicability to large systems and long timescales. To address this limitation, we developed a machine learning-driven PIMD (MLPIMD) workflow for the accurate and efficient prediction of NMR observables, in which NQEs at finite temperature are explicitly included. As a demonstration, we investigate the experimentally measured isotropic chemical shifts, δ iso , of the 3 He monomer ( 3 He@C 70 6- ) and dimer ( 3 He 2 @C 70 6- ) endohedral fullerene hexaanions. The resulting predictions show excellent agreement with the experiment and reveal a pronounced influence of NQEs on the 3 He chemical shifts in both systems. In particular, NQEs are found to play a key role in determining the chemical-shift difference between the monomer and dimer species. The methodology introduced here is broadly applicable and provides a general framework for investigating NMR observables sensitive to NQEs in complex molecular systems.
items.summary_zh: 开发机器学习驱动的路径积分分子动力学（MLPIMD）流程，在有限温度下显式纳入核量子效应，用于预测 3 He@C 70 6- 和 3 He 2@C 70 6- 的 NMR 各向同性化学位移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法在实验测得的 endohedral fullerene 化学位移上取得良好一致性，并显示核量子效应决定单体与二聚体的位移差异，为扩展到更大体系提供计算框架。当前演示仅涉及两种 fullerene hexaanion，通用性和长期尺度效率仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 核量子效应（NQEs）对于准确描述含轻元素的体系至关重要。在经典模拟中忽略 NQEs，可能导致理论预测与实验测量之间出现显著偏差，尤其是对于对量子核运动高度敏感的核磁共振（NMR）观测量。尽管可以使用从头算路径积分分子动力学（AI-PIMD）严格处理 NQEs，但这类模拟的高计算成本仍限制了其在大体系和长时间尺度上的应用。为解决这一限制，我们开发了一种机器学习驱动的 PIMD（MLPIMD）流程，用于准确且高效地预测 NMR 观测量，其中显式纳入有限温度下的 NQEs。作为示例，我们研究了实验测得的 endohedral fullerene hexaanion 单体（3 He@C 70 6-）和二聚体（3 He 2@C 70 6-）的各向同性化学位移 δ iso。所得预测与实验符合良好，并揭示了 NQEs 对两个体系中 3 He 化学位移的显著影响。特别是，NQEs 被发现对决定单体与二聚体物种之间的化学位移差异发挥关键作用。所提出的方法具有广泛适用性，为研究复杂分子体系中对 NQEs 敏感的 NMR 观测量提供了通用框架。

items.title: A multispecies foundation model for genome function prediction, gene annotation and sequence design
items.abstract_or_text: Comparative genomics and synthetic biology require models that can interpret, annotate, and design DNA sequences across species, yet genomic models have not combined these capabilities beyond a few well-characterized organisms. Here we introduce Nucleotide Transformer v3 (NTv3), a long-context cross-kingdom foundation model that provides a common backbone for functional prediction, gene annotation and controllable sequence generation across phylogenetically diverse species. NTv3 is pre-trained on more than 128,000 genomes using sequences up to 1Mb and post-trained on 16,262 functional tracks across 15 animal and plant genomes. NTv3 performs comparably to AlphaGenome on matched human assays and matches or exceeds evaluated published models for functional-track prediction across 19 species spanning mammals, birds, fish, plants, fungi and protists. Ablation experiments show that both genome pre-training and expanding functional supervision from human and mouse to 15 species improve track prediction. Leveraging these learned functional representations, NTv3 outperforms leading ab initio gene predictors across mammals, plants and insects, with fewer spurious gene models and improved recovery and reduced fragmentation of long genes. Finally, the same representations can be used with discrete diffusion to design regulatory DNA sequences with specific activity levels. We demonstrate this in plant and fly promoters and enhancers, and experimentally validate the activity and promoter selectivity of the generated fly enhancers. Together, NTv3 unifies genome interpretation, gene annotation and regulatory sequence design across the animal and plant kingdoms, with direct relevance to agriculture, biodiversity research and biotechnology.
items.summary_zh: 提出跨物种、长上下文的 Nucleotide Transformer v3（NTv3），统一支持基因组功能预测、基因注释和可控调控 DNA 序列设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: NTv3 在 19 个物种的功能轨迹预测、跨类群基因注释和调控序列设计上表现出广泛能力，并对生成的 fly enhancers 做了实验验证。限制是训练和评估仍依赖特定功能轨迹与物种，摘要未说明更广泛体内功能和安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 比较基因组学和合成生物学需要能够跨物种解读、注释和设计 DNA 序列的模型，但现有基因组模型尚未在少数研究充分的生物之外整合这些能力。在这里，我们提出 Nucleotide Transformer v3（NTv3），一种长上下文、跨界的基础模型，为系统发育多样的物种提供功能预测、基因注释和可控序列生成的共同骨干。NTv3 使用长度最高达 1Mb 的序列在超过 128,000 个基因组上进行预训练，并在 15 个动植物基因组的 16,262 条功能轨迹上进行后训练。在匹配的人类测定中，NTv3 的表现与 AlphaGenome 相当；在覆盖哺乳动物、鸟类、鱼类、植物、真菌和原生生物的 19 个物种中，其功能轨迹预测表现达到或超过所评估的已发表模型。消融实验表明，基因组预训练以及将功能监督从人类和小鼠扩展到 15 个物种，都能改善轨迹预测。利用这些学到的功能表征，NTv3 在哺乳动物、植物和昆虫中的表现超过领先的从头基因预测器，产生的错误基因模型更少，同时对长基因的恢复更好、片段化更少。最后，同样的表征还可与离散扩散结合，用于设计具有特定活性水平的调控 DNA 序列。我们在植物和果蝇启动子与增强子中展示了这一点，并对生成的果蝇增强子的活性和启动子选择性进行了实验验证。总之，NTv3 将动物界和植物界中的基因组解读、基因注释与调控序列设计统一起来，对农业、生物多样性研究和生物技术具有直接意义。

items.title: Gold deposition on surfaces using small organic molecules: effects of preparation conditions on morphology and Raman response
items.abstract_or_text: Reduction and subsequent deposition of noble metals from simple salt solutions on solid surfaces remains challenging. We describe deposition of gold (nano)-particles from an aqueous chloroauric adic solution on glass and polyethylene surfaces at ambient temperature by adding simple primordial organic molecules. The deposited gold structures showed differences in morphology, size and Raman response across the preparation conditions examined, motivating further investigation of their potential as functional surface coatings with distinct properties for various applications. Green foundation 1 This work examines gold deposition on glass and plastic, hydrophobic and hydrophilic, surfaces using aqueous solutions of simple organic compounds at room temperature; mild reaction conditions relevant to green chemistry. 2 Light and electron microscopy revealed differences in deposit morphology across conditions with different organic compounds and reagent concentrations. 3 Cancer cell and rhodamine 6G Raman measurements were used to explore the potential of the deposited gold structures as substrates for surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy to detect biofilm compounds.

items.title: Ground-truth evaluation of sparse autoencoder features on spatial, single-cell and language-model embeddings
items.abstract_or_text: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used to extract interpretable features from the embeddings of biological foundation models. Because SAEs trained with different random seeds learn different features, reproducibility across seeds has become a common test of whether these features can be trusted. We asked whether reproducible features are also meaningful, using embeddings whose concepts are known: five spatial transcriptomics embeddings of two colorectal cancer sections and Geneformer embeddings of single-cell RNA profiles, with cell lineages as concepts; synthetic data with planted cell states; and the residual stream of a small language model, with token classes as concepts. Varimax rotations of the same embeddings were almost perfectly reproducible, yet rotation features (PCA, varimax and ICA) covered at most three of seven lineages and three of eight token classes. Single SAE fits showed the opposite profile: they covered most concepts with purer gene programs but reproduced only 27-46% of their features. A consensus over five SAE fits combined the two strengths. It was reproducible (78-98% across sources) and as pure as single fits: 11-40% of its features carried marker genes of another lineage, against 44-70% for varimax. Against the strongest baseline, varimax sparsified to the SAE's sparsity, the consensus covered as many concepts on PCA and Geneformer embeddings and more on learned spatial and text embeddings. The consensus also had costs. It covered fewer lineages than single fits and, like all SAEs, missed weak planted states that rotations recovered; neither a longer single fit nor a second SAE trained on the consensus residual recovered what it discarded. Reproducibility alone therefore ranks features poorly: SAE features should be reported with the number of known concepts they cover and the purity of their gene programs, against a rotation of the same embedding sparsified to the SAE's sparsity.
items.summary_zh: 该研究评估稀疏自编码器在空间转录组、单细胞 RNA 和语言模型嵌入上的可解释特征，发现单次拟合覆盖概念较广但跨随机种子复现率低，五次拟合共识可提升复现性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；以已知细胞谱系和人工植入状态作为 ground truth，直接检验 SAE 特征的覆盖率、纯度与复现性，为生物基础模型可解释性评估提供了可操作标准。
items.abstract_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）越来越多地用于从生物基础模型的嵌入中提取可解释特征。由于不同随机种子训练的 SAE 会学习到不同特征，跨种子复现性已成为判断这些特征能否被信任的常见测试。我们考察可复现的特征是否同样具有意义，所用嵌入包括：来自两个结直肠癌切片的五种空间转录组嵌入；Geneformer 的单细胞 RNA 表达谱嵌入，以细胞谱系作为概念；植入细胞状态的合成数据；以及一个小型语言模型的残差流，以词元类别作为概念。对同一嵌入进行 Varimax 旋转几乎完全可复现，但旋转特征（PCA、Varimax 和 ICA）最多覆盖七个谱系中的三个，以及八个词元类别中的三个。单次 SAE 拟合呈现相反的特征：以更纯的基因程序覆盖大多数概念，但只能复现其 27–46% 的特征。对五次 SAE 拟合取共识结合了两者优点。该共识在不同来源上的复现率为 78–98%，纯度与单次拟合相当：在 Varimax 中，11–40% 的特征携带另一谱系的标记基因，而稀疏化前的 Varimax 为 44–70%。与最强基线——稀疏度与 SAE 相同的 Varimax——相比，共识在 PCA 和 Geneformer 嵌入上覆盖了相同数量的概念，在学习得到的空间和文本嵌入上覆盖了更多概念。共识也有代价：它覆盖的谱系少于单次拟合，并且像所有 SAE 一样会遗漏旋转方法恢复的弱植入状态；更长的单次拟合或在共识残差上训练第二个 SAE 都无法恢复这些被丢弃的状态。因此，仅凭复现性对特征排序并不充分：应报告 SAE 特征覆盖的已知概念数量及其基因程序纯度，并与将相同嵌入稀疏化到 SAE 稀疏度的旋转方法进行比较。

items.title: Keratin 17 Defines an Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition-Associated Migratory Cell State in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
items.abstract_or_text: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by early invasion, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance that contribute substantially to its poor clinical outcome. Keratin 17 (K17) is a recognized marker of the aggressive basal-like subtype of PDAC and an independent predictor of adverse prognosis; however, the biological basis for this association remains incompletely understood. To define K17-associated cellular programs, we integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from 42 patients, Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC) proteomic data from 140 tumors, MACSima multiplex spatial imaging of 63 patients, dual-plex immunohistochemistry of 60 cases, and three-dimensional spheroid migration assays. Single-cell transcriptomic analysis demonstrated significant enrichment of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-associated gene programs among K17-positive malignant epithelial cells. Consistent with this finding, K17-positive tumors in the CPTAC cohort exhibited enrichment of the Hallmark EMT pathway at the protein level. Among six candidate markers identified through transcriptomic analyses, laminin subunit gamma-2 (LAMC2) was the only candidate associated with K17 at every validation step. Tumors positive for both K17 and LAMC2 had significantly worse overall survival than double-negative tumors (adjusted hazard ratio = 2.53). Multiplex spatial imaging localized K17-positive cells predominantly to poorly differentiated tumor regions and demonstrated frequent single-cell co-expression with LAMC2. Whole-slide dual-plex immunohistochemistry further confirmed the association between K17 and LAMC2 and showed progressive enrichment of K17/LAMC2-positive tumor cells with increasing intratumoral histologic grade. Functionally, gain- and loss-of-function studies in three-dimensional PDAC spheroids demonstrated that K17 promotes migratory outgrowth, and differences in proliferation did not account for this effect. Collectively, these findings identify K17 as a marker of a poorly differentiated, EMT-associated migratory cell state in PDAC and provide functional evidence that K17 contributes to tumor-cell migration.
items.summary_zh: 研究整合 42 名患者单细胞 RNA、140 个 CPTAC 肿瘤蛋白质组、63 名患者空间成像、60 例免疫组化和三维球体实验，定位 K17/LAMC2 相关的 PDAC 迁移细胞状态。

items.abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）的特征包括早期侵袭、转移和治疗耐药，这些因素共同导致其不良临床结局。角蛋白 17（K17）是 PDAC 高侵袭性基底样亚型的公认标志物，也是不良预后的独立预测因子；然而，这种关联的生物学基础仍未完全阐明。为界定 K17 相关的细胞程序，我们整合了来自 42 名患者的单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据、来自 140 个肿瘤的 Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium（CPTAC）蛋白质组数据、来自 63 名患者的 MACSima 多重空间成像数据、60 例病例的双重免疫组化，以及三维球体迁移实验。单细胞转录组分析显示，K17 阳性恶性上皮细胞显著富集上皮—间质转化（EMT）相关基因程序。与此一致，CPTAC 队列中的 K17 阳性肿瘤在蛋白质水平富集 Hallmark EMT 通路。在转录组分析确定的 6 个候选标志物中，层粘连蛋白亚基 γ-2（LAMC2）是在每一步验证中都与 K17 相关的唯一候选物。K17 和 LAMC2 双阳性肿瘤的总生存期显著差于双阴性肿瘤（校正风险比 = 2.53）。多重空间成像将 K17 阳性细胞主要定位于分化较差的肿瘤区域，并显示其经常与 LAMC2 发生单细胞共表达。全切片双重免疫组化进一步证实了 K17 与 LAMC2 的关联，并显示随着肿瘤内组织学分级升高，K17/LAMC2 阳性肿瘤细胞逐渐富集。三维 PDAC 球体中的功能获得和功能缺失研究显示，K17 促进迁移性向外生长，而增殖差异不能解释这一效应。总体而言，这些结果将 K17 确定为 PDAC 中一个分化差、与 EMT 相关的迁移性细胞状态标志物，并提供了 K17 促进肿瘤细胞迁移的功能证据。

items.title: IMPLICIT LEARNING: REACTION OUTCOME PREDICTION FROM POSITIVE-ONLY DATA
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning models for reaction product prediction have largely been trained and evaluated on datasets of successful reactions. While this setting allows reaching high accuracy scores, these models generally struggle to discriminate between successful and unsuccessful transformations due to the lack of negative training data. This critically limits their practical use, as reliably recognizing unproductive substrate combinations in silico is required to accelerate experimental campaigns and save resources in the laboratory. While the availability of negative reaction data remains limited to date, we show that even purely positive datasets implicitly contain a significant amount of information about cases in which no reaction occurs. To exploit this, we introduce TACIT (TAckling Chemistry through ImpliciT negative learning). While trained on positive-only data, TACIT learns to distinguish between productive and unproductive transformations. On two published high-throughput experimentation datasets, it outperforms all evaluated reaction outcome prediction models in separating successful from failed reactions. Crucially, TACIT’s accuracy on the popular USPTO-MIT benchmark remains competitive, despite its added ability to predict negative reaction outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 提出 TACIT（TAckling Chemistry through ImpliciT negative learning），从仅含成功反应的正样本数据中学习隐含的失败反应信息，以区分有产物和无产物的底物组合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 反应结果模型若只能预测成功反应，难以筛除无效实验；TACIT 在两个高通量实验数据集上优于比较模型，并在 USPTO-MIT 上保持竞争力。需要留意的是，方法依赖正样本数据中的隐含负信息，负反应覆盖和跨数据集泛化仍是关键问题。
items.abstract_zh: 反应产物预测的机器学习模型大多在成功反应数据集上训练和评估。虽然这种设置可以达到较高的准确率，但由于缺乏负训练数据，这些模型通常难以区分成功和不成功的转化。这严重限制了它们的实际应用，因为在计算机中可靠识别无效的底物组合，对于加速实验活动和节省实验室资源是必需的。尽管目前负反应数据仍然有限，我们表明，即使是纯正样本数据，也隐含包含了大量关于不发生反应情形的信息。为利用这些信息，我们提出 TACIT（TAckling Chemistry through ImpliciT negative learning）。TACIT 仅使用正样本数据训练，却能够区分有产物和无产物的转化。在两个已发表的高通量实验数据集上，它在区分成功反应和失败反应方面优于所有评估的反应结果预测模型。重要的是，尽管新增了预测负反应结果的能力，TACIT 在常用的 USPTO-MIT 基准上的准确率仍具有竞争力。

items.title: From group-level neurophysiological biomarkers to individual-level phenotyping to identify mechanisms of neurodegenerative disease
items.abstract_or_text: Precision medicine approaches require physiological effects to be informative when translated to the individual. Reliable group differences may have limited individual value when distributions overlap, mechanisms are heterogeneous, or patients differ in phenotype. A feature can differ between group means and still overlap heavily across individuals Moreover, combinations of physiological abnormalities may reveal subject-level structure that is not captured by any single marker at the group level. We evaluate the translation between group- and individual-level features derived from resting-state magnetoencephalography (MEG) using behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) and progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) as demonstrator conditions. These illnesses have distinct molecular pathology but share the pressing need for therapeutic development and have partially overlapping clinical and physiological features. We combine clinical phenotype, power spectral density (PSD), and latent network mechanisms inferred by dynamic causal modelling (DCM) to compare groups and to access their individuals mapping translations. We used classification as an exploratory probe of how group-defined physiological features from 74 healthy controls, 45 participants with bvFTD and 55 participants with PSP support individual assignment. Clinical scores showed strong individual-level translation, consistent with clinical diagnostic definitions (e.g, controls-vs-PSP accuracy 0.94; bvFTD-vs-PSP accuracy 0.83). MEG spectra feature classified individuals weakly (accuracy ~0.6), despite group level re-organization (e.g., reduced beta-band and increased fronto-insular alpha-phase/beta-amplitude coupling in bvFTD). Inferred biophysical parameters gave intermediate performance (e.g. PSP-vs-control accuracy 0.70; bvFTD-vs-PSP accuracy 0.74) while retaining mechanistic interpretability. Using this approach, experimental medicine studies of neurological disease can formally trade between mechanistic insight and classification performance, in using biomarkers that can account for individual heterogeneity within and between diagnostic groups.
items.summary_zh: 研究将静息态 MEG 的群体差异与个体级分类联系起来，在 bvFTD、PSP 和健康对照中比较临床特征、频谱和动态因果模型参数的个体判别能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；展示了机制解释与个体预测之间的量化权衡，但样本量有限，分类被明确定位为探索性分析，不能视为临床诊断验证。
items.abstract_zh: 精准医学要求生理效应在转化到个体层面时具有信息价值。当分布重叠、机制异质或患者表型不同时，可靠的组间差异可能对个体价值有限。某个特征即使在组均值之间存在差异，也可能在个体间高度重叠。此外，生理异常的组合可能揭示组层面单个标志物无法捕捉的个体结构。我们使用静息态脑磁图（MEG）评估从组层面到个体层面的特征转化，以行为变异型额颞叶痴呆（bvFTD）和进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）为示范疾病。这两种疾病具有不同的分子病理，但都迫切需要治疗开发，并且临床和生理特征部分重叠。我们结合临床表型、功率谱密度（PSD）以及由动态因果建模（DCM）推断的潜在网络机制，比较组别并考察个体层面的映射转化。我们使用 74 名健康对照、45 名 bvFTD 参与者和 55 名 PSP 参与者的数据；分类作为探索性工具，用于检验组层面定义的生理特征能否支持个体归类。临床评分显示出较强的个体层面转化，与临床诊断定义一致（例如，对照与 PSP 的准确率为 0.94；bvFTD 与 PSP 为 0.83）。尽管组层面发生了重组，MEG 频谱特征对个体的分类较弱（准确率约 0.6），例如 bvFTD 中 β 频带降低以及额岛 α 相位/β 振幅耦合增加。推断的生物物理参数表现居中，同时保留机制可解释性（例如 PSP 与对照的准确率为 0.70；bvFTD 与 PSP 为 0.74）。这种方法使神经疾病实验医学研究能够在机制洞见与分类性能之间进行形式化权衡，并使用能够解释诊断组内及组间个体异质性的生物标志物。

items.title: CSF Alzheimer's Disease Biomarkers in Relation to Functional Status and Tofersen Treatment Response in ALS
items.abstract_or_text: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease primarily affecting motor neurons but also frequently involving cognitive impairment. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) measurements of {beta} amyloid peptides (A{beta}40, A{beta}42), tau proteins, and neurofilaments are clinically established biomarkers in neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease (AD). Emerging evidence suggests that AD-related pathological changes and AD-related biomarkers may appear in ALS, yet their diagnostic and prognostic significance remains unclear. In this retrospective study, we analyzed clinical and CSF biomarker data from patients with ALS, AD, Huntington's disease (HD), and other disease controls recruited in a real-world clinical setting. The dataset comprised A{beta}40, A{beta}42, total tau (t-Tau), phosphorylated tau181 (pTau181), phosphorylated neurofilament heavy chain (pNfH), and relevant serum markers. Additionally, longitudinal CSF sampling over one year was evaluated in three ALS patients receiving tofersen treatment. In this real-world cohort, AD-related CSF biomarkers demonstrated no diagnostic value for distinguishing ALS from other neurodegenerative conditions. However, A{beta}40, A{beta}42, and pTau181 levels correlated positively with ALS Functional Rating Scale (ALSFRS-R) global score and serum Creatine Kinase MB (CK-MB) concentrations. At the same time, a higher A{beta}42/A{beta}40 ratio was associated with better memory performance on the Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS). In tofersen-treated cases, AD-related biomarkers gradually declined during follow-up. These findings suggest that elevated CSF AD-associated biomarkers in ALS may reflect preserved functional and cognitive status and exhibited parallel declines during follow-up in three tofersen-treated patients, supporting their further prospective evaluation as exploratory markers of therapeutic responsiveness.
items.summary_zh: 在 ALS、AD、HD 等真实世界队列中，CSF AD 相关标志物不能区分 ALS 与其他神经退行性疾病，但与 ALS 功能和记忆指标相关；3 名接受 tofersen 的 ALS 患者中这些标志物随访下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本、临床观察性研究；结果支持把这些指标作为探索性功能或治疗反应标志物，而不是诊断标志物，且 tofersen 结果仅来自 3 例患者。
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种主要累及运动神经元、但也经常伴随认知损害的神经退行性疾病。脑脊液（CSF）中的 β 淀粉样蛋白肽（Aβ40、Aβ42）、tau 蛋白和神经丝是阿尔茨海默病（AD）等神经退行性疾病中已建立的临床生物标志物。越来越多的证据表明，AD 相关病理改变和 AD 相关生物标志物可能出现在 ALS 中，但其诊断和预后意义仍不清楚。在这项回顾性研究中，我们分析了真实世界临床环境中招募的 ALS、AD、亨廷顿病（HD）及其他疾病对照患者的临床和 CSF 生物标志物数据。数据集包括 Aβ40、Aβ42、总 tau（t-Tau）、磷酸化 tau181（pTau181）、磷酸化神经丝重链（pNfH）及相关血清标志物。此外，我们评估了 3 名接受 tofersen 治疗的 ALS 患者为期一年的纵向 CSF 采样。在这一真实世界队列中，AD 相关 CSF 生物标志物没有区分 ALS 与其他神经退行性疾病的诊断价值。然而，Aβ40、Aβ42 和 pTau181 水平与 ALS 功能量表全球评分（ALSFRS-R）及血清肌酸激酶 MB（CK-MB）浓度呈正相关。同时，更高的 Aβ42/Aβ40 比值与爱丁堡认知和行为 ALS 筛查（ECAS）中更好的记忆表现相关。在接受 tofersen 治疗的病例中，AD 相关生物标志物在随访期间逐渐下降。这些发现提示，ALS 中升高的 CSF AD 相关生物标志物可能反映较好的功能和认知状态，并在 3 名接受 tofersen 治疗的患者中随访同步下降，支持将其作为治疗反应探索性标志物开展进一步前瞻性评估。

items.title: Association Between Clinical Characteristics Within 24 Hours of ICU Admission and the Risk of Sepsis-Induced Coagulopathy Within 72 Hours in Patients with Immunosuppressed Sepsis: Machine Learning Model Development and External Validation Based on the MIMIC-IV and eICU Databases
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Objective To develop and externally validate a machine learning model for the early prediction of the risk of sepsis-induced coagulopathy (SIC) within 72 hours of admission to the intensive care unit (ICU) in patients with immunosuppressed sepsis. Methods This was a retrospective cohort study.A total of 1,311 patients with immunosuppressed sepsis were enrolled from the MIMIC-IV database, and clinical data within 24 hours of ICU admission were extracted. After multiple interpolations, the dataset was randomly split into training and validation sets in a 7:3 ratio. Ten predictive variables were selected using a correlation heatmap (FDR-corrected) combined with recursive feature elimination. Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Artificial Neural Network. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA). The best model was externally validated in the eICU cohort (n = 576), and interpretability analysis was performed using the SHAP method. Results Among the 1,311 patients in the MIMIC-IV cohort, 148 (11.3%) developed SIC within 72 hours; among the 576 patients in the eICU cohort, 52 (9.0%) developed SIC. Ultimately, 10 predictive variables were identified:platelet count (PLT), Elixhauser Comorbidity Index, lactate (Lac), activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT), mean corpuscular hemoglobin (MCH), Simplified Acute Physiology Score II (SAPS II), hourly urine output (Urine_Rate), white blood cell count (WBC), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and body temperature(T). In the validation set, the AUC for the logistic regression (LR) model was the highest (0.819, 95% CI: 0.761–0.867), but it exhibited poor calibration in the high-probability range;the ANN demonstrated the best overall performance (AUC 0.778, 95% CI: 0.704–0.844; PR-AUC 0.327; accuracy 0.788; specificity 0.805; F1 score 0.411) and was selected as the final model.In the external validation cohort, the ANN maintained good discriminatory power (AUC 0.768, 95% CI: 0.709–0.825), with a sensitivity of 0.885 and a negative predictive value of 0.981. SHAP analysis revealed that PLT was the most influential predictive variable, followed by the Elixhauser Comorbidity Index and lactate. Conclusion An interpretable ANN model built on 10 routine clinical variables can accurately predict the occurrence of SIC within 72 hours of ICU admission in immunosuppressed patients with sepsis and demonstrates good generalizability in an independent multicenter cohort. It is expected to provide a practical tool for early warning and stratified management of coagulopathy in this high-risk population.
items.summary_zh: 研究用 MIMIC-IV（1,311 例）训练并在 eICU（576 例）外部验证免疫抑制脓毒症患者 72 小时内脓毒症诱导凝血病风险，最终模型为可解释 ANN。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本、回顾性多中心研究；具有独立外部验证和 SHAP 分析，但仍是观察性预测模型，不能据此推断变量对 SIC 的因果作用或临床获益。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：开发并外部验证一种机器学习模型，用于早期预测免疫抑制脓毒症患者入 ICU 后 72 小时内发生脓毒症诱导凝血病（SIC）的风险。方法：这是一项回顾性队列研究。从 MIMIC-IV 数据库纳入 1,311 名免疫抑制脓毒症患者，提取入 ICU 后 24 小时内的临床数据。经过多重插补后，数据集按 7:3 随机分为训练集和验证集。使用相关性热图（经 FDR 校正）结合递归特征消除选择变量，并比较 Logistic 回归、决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、支持向量机（SVM）和人工神经网络。模型性能通过受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估；最佳模型在 eICU 队列（n = 576）中进行外部验证，并使用 SHAP 进行可解释性分析。结果：在 MIMIC-IV 队列的 1,311 名患者中，148 人（11.3%）在 72 小时内发生 SIC；在 eICU 队列的 576 名患者中，52 人（9.0%）发生 SIC。最终确定 10 个预测变量：血小板计数（PLT）、Elixhauser 合并症指数、乳酸（Lac）、活化部分凝血活酶时间（APTT）、平均红细胞血红蛋白量（MCH）、简化急性生理学评分 II（SAPS II）、每小时尿量（Urine_Rate）、白细胞计数（WBC）、血尿素氮（BUN）和体温（T）。在验证集中，Logistic 回归模型的 AUC 最高（0.819，95% CI 0.761–0.867），但在高概率范围内校准较差；ANN 的总体表现最佳（AUC 0.778，95% CI 0.704–0.844；PR-AUC 0.327；准确率 0.788；特异度 0.805；F1 分数 0.411），因此被选为最终模型。在外部验证队列中，ANN 保持了良好的区分能力（AUC 0.768，95% CI 0.709–0.825），敏感度为 0.885，阴性预测值为 0.981。SHAP 分析显示，PLT 是影响最大的变量，其次是 Elixhauser 合并症指数和乳酸。结论：由 10 个常规临床变量构建的可解释 ANN 模型能够准确预测免疫抑制脓毒症患者入 ICU 后 72 小时内发生 SIC，并在独立多中心队列中表现出良好的泛化性。该模型有望为这一高风险人群的早期预警和分层管理提供实用工具。

items.title: Generative design of functional disordered regions in a developmental transcription factor
items.abstract_or_text: Rapid advances in protein structure design have not translated to intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs). This is largely due to our incomplete understanding of how IDR sequence encodes function. Here, we use stem cell differentiation as a model to map functional sequence features in the IDR of transcription factor RUNX2. We show that RUNX2 requires its C-terminal IDR to bind chromatin and regulate gene expression during osteogenesis. Surprisingly, linear IDR sequence is dispensable, and instead features of the conformational ensemble predict function. We develop an algorithm for rational IDR design based on biophysical principles, and use it to generate functional IDRs de novo. Together, these results illustrate the central role for TF IDRs in chromatin binding and extend generative protein design beyond the folded proteome.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 RUNX2 干细胞分化模型解析内在无序区（IDR）的功能序列特征，发现构象集合而非线性序列更能预测染色质结合和成骨调控，并据此设计功能性 IDR。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；将无序蛋白区域的生物物理设计与干细胞功能实验结合，扩展了生成式蛋白设计范围；摘要未给出设计数量、成功率和更广泛验证规模。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构设计的快速进展尚未转化到内在无序区（IDR），主要原因是我们对 IDR 序列如何编码功能的理解仍不完整。在此，我们以干细胞分化为模型，绘制转录因子 RUNX2 的 IDR 中的功能序列特征。我们显示，RUNX2 需要其 C 端 IDR 才能在成骨过程中结合染色质并调控基因表达。令人意外的是，线性 IDR 序列并非必需；相反，构象集合的特征可以预测功能。我们基于生物物理学原理开发了一种用于理性 IDR 设计的算法，并用它从头生成具有功能的 IDR。总体而言，这些结果说明转录因子 IDR 在染色质结合中的核心作用，并将生成式蛋白设计扩展到了折叠蛋白质组之外。

items.title: Species phylogenetics using intraprotein residue dependence inferred with protein foundation models
items.abstract_or_text: Traditional molecular phylogenetic inference uses multiple sequence alignments and amino acid substitution models that generally assume that sites evolve independently. In contrast, protein foundation models (pFMs) are deep learning models that reveal residue dependence patterns within sequences. There are two types of pFMs: Evolutionary Scale Models (esm-pFM) for analyzing individual protein sequences, and MSA Transformer (msat-pFM) models for analyzing MSAs. Using pFMs to analyze sequences produces residue attention matrices (RAMs) and sequence attention matrices (SAMs), respectively. RAMs and SAMs can be used to estimate pairwise distances and, thus, reconstruct phylogenies using the Neighbor-Joining (NJ) method. Here, we compare the performance of RAM-NJ and SAM-NJ phylogenies in reconstructing established species relationships across different proteins and taxon sets. Surprisingly, RAM-NJ phylogenies were generally as accurate as SAM-NJ phylogenies even though RAM inference does not require construction or analysis of an MSA. Our results show that pFM-based analyses can recover species relationships without conventional substitution models or, in the case of RAMs, a multiple sequence alignment. These results suggest that evolutionary relationships are reflected not only in primary sequence differences between species, but also in the sequence-specific patterns of inter-residue dependence produced by pFM analysis of individual sequences. However, pFM phylogenies are less accurate than those obtained with standard maximum likelihood approaches, underscoring the need to further develop methods to harness RAMs and SAMs more effectively.
items.summary_zh: 利用蛋白质基础模型的残基注意力矩阵（RAM）和序列注意力矩阵（SAM）估计物种间距离，并用 Neighbor-Joining 重建系统发育关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RAM-NJ 在不构建多序列比对（MSA）的情况下通常可达到 SAM-NJ 的准确度，说明单条蛋白序列中的残基依赖模式包含系统发育信息。需要注意的是，pFM 系统发育仍不如标准最大似然方法准确，方法尚未成熟。
items.abstract_zh: 传统的分子系统发育推断使用多序列比对和氨基酸替换模型，通常假设各位点独立演化。相比之下，蛋白质基础模型（pFMs）是能够揭示序列内残基依赖模式的深度学习模型。pFM 有两类：用于分析单条蛋白质序列的 Evolutionary Scale Models（esm-pFM），以及用于分析 MSA 的 MSA Transformer（msat-pFM）模型。使用 pFM 分析序列会分别产生残基注意力矩阵（RAM）和序列注意力矩阵（SAM）。RAM 和 SAM 可用于估计成对距离，并据此使用 Neighbor-Joining（NJ）方法重建系统发育树。在这里，我们比较了 RAM-NJ 和 SAM-NJ 系统发育树在不同蛋白质和分类单元集合中重建既有物种关系的表现。令人意外的是，尽管 RAM 推断不需要构建或分析 MSA，RAM-NJ 系统发育树通常与 SAM-NJ 系统发育树同样准确。我们的结果表明，基于 pFM 的分析无需传统替换模型即可恢复物种关系；在 RAM 的情况下，甚至不需要多序列比对。这些结果提示，演化关系不仅反映在物种之间的一级序列差异中，也反映在 pFM 分析单条序列产生的序列特异性残基间依赖模式中。然而，pFM 系统发育的准确度低于标准最大似然方法，说明仍需进一步发展更有效利用 RAM 和 SAM 的方法。

items.title: Amniotic Fluid Stem Cell-Derived Secretome MRG1061 Improves Alveolarisation and Reduces Lung Inflammation in Experimental Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC)-derived secretomes are emerging as scalable, cell-free candidates for regenerative and immunomodulatory therapy, but their mechanistic cargo signatures and translational potential remain incompletely defined. We developed MRG1061, a clinically translatable, amniotic fluid-derived stem cell (AFSC)-derived secretome produced using the proprietary Secretomix® platform, and sought to define its protein cargo, predict key inflammatory and regenerative pathways, and functionally validate these predictions in human in vitro systems and an in vivo model of lung injury. Methods Proteomic profiling of MRG1061 was performed across multiple batches and analysed using pathway enrichment and disease-annotation tools to identify inflammation- and repair-relevant signatures, including blinded enrichment for bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) and related chronic inflammatory conditions. Predicted anti-inflammatory and regenerative activities were then tested in human in vitro assays using lipopolysaccharide-stimulated peripheral blood mononuclear cells, an NF-κB reporter lung adenocarcinoma cell line, primary human alveolar epithelial cells, and human lung fibroblasts. To assess in vivo relevance, MRG1061 was evaluated in a neonatal hyperoxia-induced lung injury model, with quantitative analyses of lung structure and inflammatory gene expression. A separate study in healthy mice assessed systemic safety by repeated dosing and serum biochemistry. Results MRG1061 contained extracellular vesicles and a complex protein cargo enriched for pathways linked to innate and adaptive immune regulation, NF-κB signalling, redox homeostasis, apoptosis, and disease annotations that included BPD. Consistent with these predictions, MRG1061 reduced inflammatory gene and protein expression and NF-κB activity in human immune and lung epithelial assays, modulated disturbed proliferation of primary human alveolar epithelial cells, and decreased stress-induced senescence in lung fibroblasts. In neonatal hyperoxia-exposed mice, MRG1061 improved lung architecture and attenuated expression of key inflammatory cytokines and inflammasome components. Repeated administration to healthy mice revealed no adverse effects on survival or standard serum biochemical parameters. Conclusions MRG1061 exhibits a cargo-defined, multi-modal anti-inflammatory and regenerative profile that translates into measurable effects in human in vitro systems and in vivo lung injury, while maintaining a favourable safety signal in healthy animals. These data support further development of MRG1061 as a stem cell-free biologic for inflammatory and degenerative lung disease.
items.summary_zh: MRG1061 是由羊水来源干细胞分泌组制备的无细胞候选疗法；蛋白质组、人体细胞实验和新生小鼠高氧肺损伤模型均显示抗炎及促肺泡化信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；同时提供多批次蛋白质组、人体体外和动物体内证据，并报告健康小鼠重复给药的安全信号，但尚无人体疗效或因果机制的临床证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：间充质基质细胞（MSC）来源的分泌组正在成为可规模化的无细胞再生和免疫调节候选物，但其机制性货物特征和转化潜力仍未得到充分界定。我们开发了 MRG1061，这是一种由羊水来源干细胞（AFSC）产生、通过专有 Secretomix® 平台制备的、具有临床转化潜力的分泌组；本研究旨在界定其蛋白质货物，预测关键炎症和再生通路，并在人体体外系统和肺损伤体内模型中对这些预测进行功能验证。方法：对 MRG1061 进行多批次蛋白质组分析，并使用通路富集和疾病注释工具识别与炎症和修复相关的特征，包括对支气管肺发育不良（BPD）及相关慢性炎症疾病进行盲法富集分析。随后，在脂多糖刺激的外周血单个核细胞、NF-κB 报告型肺腺癌细胞系、原代人肺泡上皮细胞和人肺成纤维细胞中测试预测的抗炎和再生活性。为评估体内相关性，在新生小鼠高氧诱导的肺损伤模型中评估 MRG1061，并定量分析肺结构和炎症基因表达。另在健康小鼠中通过重复给药和血清生化检测评估全身安全性。结果：MRG1061 含有细胞外囊泡和复杂蛋白质货物，其富集通路与先天性和适应性免疫调节、NF-κB 信号、氧化还原稳态和凋亡相关，疾病注释包括 BPD。与这些预测一致，MRG1061 在人体免疫细胞和肺上皮细胞实验中降低炎症基因和蛋白表达及 NF-κB 活性，调节原代人肺泡上皮细胞受扰的增殖，并降低肺成纤维细胞的应激诱导衰老。在新生高氧暴露小鼠中，MRG1061 改善肺结构，并减弱关键炎症细胞因子和炎症小体组分的表达。对健康小鼠重复给药未发现对生存率或常规血清生化参数的不良影响。结论：MRG1061 表现出由货物定义的多模式抗炎和再生特征，可在人体体外系统和肺损伤体内模型中产生可测量效应，同时在健康动物中呈现有利的安全信号。这些数据支持将 MRG1061 作为无干细胞生物制剂，用于炎症性和退行性肺病的进一步开发。
