items.title: In Silico Design and Evaluation of CRISPR Cytosine Base Editing Strategy for Potential Correction of the ASPA Variant Associated with Canavan Disease
items.abstract_or_text: **Background** Canavan disease is a rare autosomal recessive neurodegenerative leukodystrophy caused by pathogenic variants in the ASPA gene, for which effective molecularly targeted therapies remain limited. The NM_000049.4:c.691T>C (p.Tyr231His) variant introduces a pathogenic C-G base pair that is potentially amenable to correction using cytosine base editing (CBE). This study aimed to design and computationally evaluate a CBE-based CRISPR strategy for potential correction of this ASPA variant. **Methods** An integrated in silico workflow was used to characterize the ASPA p.Tyr231His variant and design a CBE-compatible sgRNA. Variant pathogenicity, conservation, and structural stability were assessed using multiple computational tools. Candidate sgRNAs were designed and evaluated for editing-window positioning, PAM compatibility, specificity, GC content, bystander editing, and secondary structure. Genome-wide off-target potential was further assessed using CRISPRitz against the GRCh38 reference genome. **Results** The ASPA p.Tyr231His variant was exceptionally rare (gnomAD allele frequency: 1.86 x 10^-6), highly conserved, and consistently predicted to be deleterious, with DynaMut2 indicating reduced protein stability (DDG = -2.04 kcal/mol). Of two candidate sgRNAs, one was selected based on optimal editing-window positioning, absence of predicted bystander editing, favourable GC content (45%), and specificity scores (MIT: 82; CFD: 93). RNAfold predicted minimal secondary-structure constraints (MFE: 0.00 kcal/mol). CRISPRitz identified 108 potential off-target sites, with none containing fewer than three mismatches, no bulge-associated sites, and only three predicted sites within exonic regions. **Conclusions** The integrated computational analysis identified a candidate sgRNA with favourable predicted editing characteristics and genome-wide specificity for potential CBE-mediated correction of the ASPA c.691T>C (p.Tyr231His) variant. These findings provide a rational framework for prioritizing this guide for experimental evaluation. Further cell-based and in vivo studies are required to establish editing efficiency, editing purity, bystander activity, off-target effects, and restoration of ASPA function before therapeutic applicability can be assessed.
items.summary_zh: 研究针对 Canavan 病 ASPA c.691T>C（p.Tyr231His）变体设计胞嘧啶碱基编辑 sgRNA，并以编辑窗口、旁观者编辑和全基因组脱靶预测筛选候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预印本；计算流程整合变体致病性、蛋白稳定性、sgRNA 特异性和 CRISPRitz 脱靶分析，但尚无细胞或动物编辑效率、纯度和功能恢复证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：Canavan 病是一种罕见的常染色体隐性神经退行性脑白质营养不良，由 ASPA 基因的致病变体引起，目前有效的分子靶向治疗仍然有限。NM_000049.4:c.691T>C（p.Tyr231His）变体引入了一个可能适合通过胞嘧啶碱基编辑（CBE）纠正的致病性 C-G 碱基对。本研究旨在设计并计算评估一种基于 CBE 的 CRISPR 策略，以期纠正该 ASPA 变体。方法：采用整合式计算流程表征 ASPA p.Tyr231His 变体并设计与 CBE 兼容的 sgRNA。使用多种计算工具评估变体致病性、保守性和结构稳定性。根据编辑窗口定位、PAM 兼容性、特异性、GC 含量、旁观者编辑和二级结构，对候选 sgRNA 进行设计和评估。进一步使用 CRISPRitz 针对 GRCh38 参考基因组评估全基因组脱靶潜力。结果：ASPA p.Tyr231His 变体极为罕见（gnomAD 等位基因频率：1.86 × 10^-6），高度保守，并被多个工具一致预测为有害；DynaMut2 指示蛋白稳定性降低（DDG = -2.04 kcal/mol）。两个候选 sgRNA 中，一个因编辑窗口定位最佳、未预测到旁观者编辑、GC 含量有利（45%）及特异性评分较高（MIT：82；CFD：93）而被选中。RNAfold 预测其二级结构限制最小（MFE：0.00 kcal/mol）。CRISPRitz 鉴定出 108 个潜在脱靶位点，其中没有位点少于 3 个错配，没有与 bulge 相关的位点，且只有 3 个预测位点位于外显子区域。结论：整合式计算分析确定了一个具有有利预测编辑特征和全基因组特异性的候选 sgRNA，可用于后续 CBE 介导的 ASPA c.691T>C（p.Tyr231His）纠正实验。这些结果为优先筛选该 guide 进行实验评估提供了理性框架。在评估治疗适用性之前，仍需开展细胞和体内研究，以确定编辑效率、编辑纯度、旁观者活性、脱靶效应和 ASPA 功能恢复。

items.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
items.abstract_or_text: Language model agents are post-trained and deployed through a harness, the prompts, tools, and control logic that present a task to the model and execute its outputs. Harnesses are often revised and judged by how an already trained model performs under them, which assumes that what the model learned under one harness carries over to the next. We ask what a policy learns from its harness and what survives when the harness changes. Under KL-regularized control, we show that the log odds of an optimal policy recover how strongly its harness favors each action over the others, so a trained policy carries the preferences of its harness. Deployed return then equals the ceiling of the harness, the best return it offers, minus the mismatch of the policy, the return lost to its own suboptimal decisions. Training changes only the mismatch, while changing the harness moves both terms. Comparing harnesses with a fixed model therefore mixes what each harness offers with how well that model uses it. In MiniWoB++, post-training makes a model's preferences specific to its training harness. Reversing the order of the observation fields leaves every optimal decision unchanged yet lowers a trained model's success from 85.0% to 19.2%. Conversely, every new harness that a fixed-model comparison rejects but that raises the ceiling outperforms the original agent after further training under it, and ceiling and mismatch measured beforehand predict these gains. For coding-agent harnesses on Terminal-Bench Lite, ceiling minus mismatch estimated with a stronger model as a stand-in for the optimum reproduces the accuracy ranking, while either term alone does not. Code is available at https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP.
items.summary_zh: 在 KL 正则控制下，将智能体表现分解为 harness 提供的上限与策略失配造成的损失，并用 MiniWoB++ 和 Terminal-Bench Lite 检验这一决策几何。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提醒评测智能体时要区分接口 harness 的能力与模型自身的决策质量；该分解给出了可计算的比较指标，并展示了观察字段顺序变化造成的显著性能差异。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体通过 harness（向模型呈现任务并执行其输出的提示、工具和控制逻辑）进行后训练和部署。Harness 经常被修改，并根据一个已经训练好的模型在其上的表现来评判，这隐含假设：模型在一个 harness 下学到的东西能够迁移到下一个 harness。我们研究策略从其 harness 中学到了什么，以及当 harness 改变时哪些东西能够保留下来。在 KL 正则控制下，我们证明，最优策略的对数几率可以恢复其 harness 对各个动作相对于其他动作的偏好强度，因此训练后的策略携带了其 harness 的偏好。部署回报等于 harness 的上限（它所能提供的最佳回报）减去策略失配（由策略自身的次优决策造成的回报损失）。训练只改变失配，而改变 harness 会同时改变这两项。因此，用固定模型比较 harness，会把每个 harness 能提供的东西与该模型利用它的程度混在一起。在 MiniWoB++ 中，后训练使模型的偏好特定于其训练 harness。反转观测字段的顺序不会改变任何最优决策，却会使训练后模型的成功率从 85.0% 降至 19.2%。反过来，固定模型比较时被拒绝、但能提高上限的每个新 harness，在其上进一步训练后都会超过原始智能体；事先测得的上限和失配能够预测这些收益。对于 Terminal-Bench Lite 上的编码智能体 harness，用更强模型作为最优值的替代估计得到的“上限减失配”可以复现准确率排序，而单独使用其中任一项都不能。代码见 https://github.com/2020-qqtcg/HRP。
items.author_line: Jian Mu, Ruibo Shen, Yao Shu

items.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Proprietary language models and their reasoning traces are vulnerable to API-based distillation, where an adversary trains a student model on the teacher model's outputs. To obtain evidence of distillation, model providers can watermark the teacher's outputs, aiming to leave a radioactive signal in the student's outputs. Existing black-box detectors search for such radioactivity using token-level statistics of the suspect model's outputs. However, token-level signals are not always detectable, for instance when the distillation traces are sampled at a low temperature. In this work, we discover the watermark basin, a persistent signal that enables more reliable watermark detection: during fine-tuning, watermarked teacher traces embed a distinct, key-specific geometric signal in parameter space that lies orthogonal to the ordinary task-specific fine-tuning subspace. Building on this, we introduce Watermark Basin Alignment (WM-Basin), a black-box watermark detector that queries the suspect model through its API, without access to its weights or logits. WM-Basin maps generated text to gradient representations using a fixed clean probe model, projects out the ordinary fine-tuning task directions, and tests whether the residual gradient aligns with the watermark basin induced by the watermark key. We evaluate WM-Basin extensively across diverse teacher models and student architectures (from 135M to 8.2B parameters) distilled on mathematical reasoning. At a strict 0.1% false-positive rate, WM-Basin detects 79% of distilled models at n-gram=1 and 45% at n-gram=3, substantially improving over the state-of-the-art token-level baseline (29% and 1.3%, respectively). Because the watermark signal resides in a persistent basin, it survives post-distillation modifications including quantization, pruning, and reinforcement-learning post-training.
items.summary_zh: 发现蒸馏模型参数空间中的 watermark basin，并提出无需权重或 logits 的黑盒检测器 WM-Basin；在严格 0.1% 误报率下，对数学推理蒸馏模型的检测率高于 token 级基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务、误报约束、模型规模和对比基线都较清晰，结果可复核；但它主要是数学推理模型的来源检测，不应解读为提升模型解题能力。
items.abstract_zh: 专有语言模型及其推理轨迹容易受到基于 API 的蒸馏攻击，即攻击者使用教师模型的输出训练学生模型。为了获得蒸馏证据，模型提供方可以对教师输出加水印，试图在学生输出中留下放射性信号。现有黑盒检测器通过检查可疑模型输出的 token 级统计量来寻找这种放射性，但在低温度下采样蒸馏轨迹等情况下，token 级信号并不总是可检测。本文发现了 watermark basin，这是一种能够实现更可靠水印检测的持久信号：在微调过程中，带水印的教师轨迹会在参数空间中嵌入一种独特的、与密钥相关的几何信号；该信号与普通任务特定的微调子空间正交。在此基础上，我们提出 Watermark Basin Alignment（WM-Basin），一种黑盒水印检测器，只通过 API 查询可疑模型，无需访问其权重或 logits。WM-Basin 使用固定的干净探针模型将生成文本映射为梯度表征，投影去除普通微调任务方向，并测试残余梯度是否与由水印密钥诱导的 watermark basin 对齐。我们在多种教师模型和学生架构上进行了广泛评估；这些学生模型的规模从 135M 到 8.2B 参数不等，且均通过数学推理数据蒸馏。在严格的 0.1% 误报率下，WM-Basin 在 n-gram=1 时检测出 79% 的蒸馏模型，在 n-gram=3 时检测出 45%，显著优于 token 级基线的最新方法（分别为 29% 和 1.3%）。由于水印信号位于一个持久的 basin 中，它能够经受蒸馏后的量化、剪枝和强化学习后训练等修改。

items.title: DocSkill: Skill-Integrated Agentic Reasoning for Multilingual Multi-Hop Document Question Answering
items.abstract_or_text: Multilingual multi-hop document question answering (MMHop-DocQA) requires locating and integrating evidence across complex layouts, document pages, and diverse languages. Existing approaches include single-pass processing and adaptive tool use, but learning to coordinate evidence acquisition, cross-page integration, and answer verification remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present DocSkill, an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy for adaptive evidence acquisition and reasoning. The policy selects, revisits, or skips skills according to the evolving evidence state. To construct supervision for skill orchestration, bounded Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) explores alternative skill trajectories offline. These trajectories provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We further introduce MMHop-DocBench, a multilingual multi-hop document QA dataset with training and test splits, containing 60K QA pairs across 10 languages and eight document domains. Its HopGen pipeline builds hierarchical page-element graphs to derive traceable cross-page evidence paths and generate grounded QA pairs with page- and element-level evidence annotations. Experiments show that DocSkill with Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 41.0 accuracy and 49.2 F1 on MMHop-DocBench, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.5 and 6.3 points, respectively, and achieving competitive performance on MMLongBench-Doc and DocBench.
items.summary_zh: 提出 DocSkill，通过离线有界 MCTS 学习技能编排策略，并构建带页面和元素级证据标注的多语言多跳文档问答集 MMHop-DocBench。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把证据获取、跨页整合和答案验证拆成可追踪步骤，评测同时给出准确率、F1、数据规模和跨基准结果，便于检验多跳推理是否真正依赖证据。
items.abstract_zh: 多语言多跳文档问答（MMHop-DocQA）需要在复杂版式、文档页面和多种语言之间定位并整合证据。现有方法包括单遍处理和自适应工具使用，但如何学习协调证据获取、跨页整合与答案验证仍然具有挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 DocSkill，这是一个带有学习型技能编排策略的智能体框架，用于自适应证据获取和推理。该策略根据不断变化的证据状态选择、重新访问或跳过技能。为构建技能编排的监督信号，有界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在线下探索不同的技能轨迹。这些轨迹为监督微调（SFT）提供示范，并为直接偏好优化（DPO）提供偏好对。我们进一步提出 MMHop-DocBench，这是一个多语言多跳文档问答数据集，包含训练集和测试集，覆盖 10 种语言、8 个文档领域以及 6 万个问答对。其 HopGen 流程构建分层的页面—元素图，以推导可追踪的跨页证据路径，并生成带依据的问答对，同时提供页面级和元素级证据标注。实验表明，在 MMHop-DocBench 上，使用 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 DocSkill 达到 41.0 的准确率和 49.2 的 F1，分别超过评测中最强基线 5.5 和 6.3 个百分点，并在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 DocBench 上取得具有竞争力的表现。

items.title: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Behaviorally Adequate Test Generation from Software Requirements
items.abstract_or_text: As large language model agents increasingly compile natural-language requirements into repository-level code, requirement-to-test generation grows in importance to provide validation constraints (or harness) to guide code generation. Yet it remains unclear whether current agents can generate tests that validate the required behavior when the implementation of that behavior is withheld. Existing test-generation benchmarks mostly focus on white-box testing, whereas the requirement--test-related study usually requires evaluation on semantic alignment between the given documents and the generated tests. We introduce Req2Test-Bench, a benchmark containing 5,086 execution-validated instances recovered from developer-authored behavior-driven development (BDD) artifacts in 8 open-source projects, spanning 5 programming languages and 4 BDD frameworks. Each instance pairs a natural-language requirement in Gherkin with its developer-written Test Implementation. Given the requirement, target interfaces of the required behavior, an agent must generate a complete, potentially multi-file Test Implementation. Evaluation of 8 agent--model--reasoning configurations reveals a substantial gap between execution success and behavioral adequacy, which is measured strictly as kill-completeness: a kill-complete test kills every mutant that the ground-truth test kills. The best-performing configuration, Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, produces passing tests for 82.8% of instances, yet only 33.8% are behaviorally adequate. We find that (1) scaling up agents yields sharply diminishing returns in behavioral adequacy relative to generation cost; (2) under-specified requirements cause the information gap, including ambiguous setup and implicit expected outcomes; and (3) requirement-grounded harnesses that steer agent non-determinism offer a promising direction for improvement.
items.summary_zh: 发布 Req2Test-Bench：从 8 个开源项目的 BDD 工件中整理 5,086 个可执行验证实例，并用 kill-completeness 衡量智能体生成测试是否覆盖需求行为。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将“测试能运行”与“测试真正验证需求”区分开，提供严格且可检验的行为充分性指标；结果显示通过率 82.8% 与行为充分率 33.8% 之间存在明显差距。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型智能体越来越多地将自然语言需求编译为仓库级代码，需求到测试的生成变得更加重要，因为它可以提供验证约束（或 harness）来引导代码生成。然而，当被测行为的实现被隐藏时，当前智能体能否生成验证所需行为的测试仍不清楚。现有测试生成基准大多关注白盒测试，而需求—测试相关研究通常要求评估给定文档与所生成测试之间的语义对齐。我们提出 Req2Test-Bench，这是一个包含 5,086 个经过执行验证的实例的基准，实例来自 8 个开源项目中开发者编写的行为驱动开发（BDD）工件，覆盖 5 种编程语言和 4 种 BDD 框架。每个实例将一条 Gherkin 自然语言需求与开发者编写的测试实现配对。给定需求和所需行为的目标接口，智能体必须生成一个完整的、可能跨多个文件的测试实现。对 8 种智能体—模型—推理配置的评估显示，执行成功与行为充分性之间存在显著差距；行为充分性严格按 kill-completeness 衡量，即一个测试必须杀死真实测试所杀死的每个变异体。表现最佳的配置 Codex with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 82.8% 的实例上生成通过测试，但只有 33.8% 的实例达到行为充分。我们发现：（1）相对于生成成本，扩大智能体规模会使行为充分性的收益迅速递减；（2）需求规格不足造成信息鸿沟，包括设置条件含糊和预期结果隐含；（3）以需求为依据的 harness 可以引导智能体的非确定性，是值得探索的改进方向。

items.abstract_or_text: From natural-language protein design to audit trails for omics agents. BioTender Daily Papers #91: 6 new papers (arXiv 2 + bioRxiv 3 + Nature 1) across 3 directions. 🧬 Programmable proteins & agent-guided binders • Pinal maps natural-language function goals to sequence/structure candidates and reports experimental checks across fluorescent proteins, two enzyme classes, and a metabolic H protein—design starts from “what function,” not hand-written geometry constraints. Nature peer-reviewed paper (2026-10-21); still four task families, not a universal function designer, and each system still needs its own generate–screen–develop loop. • An agent loop designs binders against local epitope windows instead of full large targets under a fixed compute budget, with yeast-display checks on some candidates. Efficiency and bias share the same root—whether the slice keeps real conformational context; arXiv preprint, not a general success rate (arXiv:2610.33195). 🧬 Peptide optimization & steerable molecular generation • CAMOLE-1 chains all-atom diffusion, physics filters, synthesis, and biochemical assays into an iterative loop for non-natural peptide MMP12 inhibitors, pushing past first hits toward selectivity, PK-relevant properties, and structural validation. Real synthesis + crystal checks on one target family—not a proven platform-wide recipe; bioRxiv preprint, not clinical evidence. • Concept bottlenecks give one-shot molecular graph generators an explicit interface to readable chemical concepts for steering and debugging, instead of opaque latent moves. Main results are distributional/validity/uniqueness metrics—not wet-lab target wins; arXiv concept-validation preprint (arXiv:2610.34227).
